definition_en: to have something as a part of a whole, or to make something part of a group
core_image: 一个圈把东西圈进去：圈里的都算数
scene: 菜单打印好了，米饭和汤已经写进套餐里。The set meal includes soup and rice.
sceneCN: 这里 include 是「包括」（第 1 个义项：作为整体的一部分）；句意：套餐包含汤和米饭。

derivatives.zh: include 加过去分词后缀，义为「包含在内的」
include 的介词用法，义为「包括」
include 加名词后缀，义为「包含；内含物」
同根形容词，义为「包含的；范围广的」

senses.title: To have as a part
senses.definition: to have something as one part of a larger whole
senses.definitionCN: 作为较大整体的一部分而存在
senses.example: The price includes breakfast.
senses.why: A whole circle drawn around items makes them part of one set.
senses.whyCN: 画一个圈把项目圈进来，它们就成了同一集合的一部分。

senses.title: To count someone in
senses.definition: to make someone or something part of a group or list
senses.definitionCN: 使某人或某物成为群体或清单的一部分
senses.example: Please include me in the game.
senses.exampleCN: 请把我也算进这场游戏。
senses.why: The circle widens to take in one more member.
senses.whyCN: 圈扩大一点，把又一名成员收进来。

senses.title: Contain as contents
senses.definition: to contain something inside, as a box holds its contents
senses.definitionCN: 像盒子装东西一样把某物含在里面
senses.example: The kit includes a small screwdriver.
senses.exampleCN: 工具包里有一把小螺丝刀。
senses.why: What the box holds is what it includes.
senses.whyCN: 盒子里装着的，就是它所包含的。

senses.title: Including: preposition use
senses.definition: used before a noun to say it is part of a larger amount
senses.definitionCN: 用在名词前，表示其属于更大的数量
senses.example: Everyone was there, including the teacher.
senses.why: The same circle idea turns into a pointing word.
senses.whyCN: 同一个圈的概念转成一个指认词。

intro.en: Include comes from Latin includere, from in- (in) + claudere (to shut, close). The original picture is to shut something in, like closing a door around it.
intro.cn: include 来自拉丁语 includere，由 in-「在内」+ claudere「关闭」构成，本义是「关在里面」，像用门把东西围住。

items.en: Latin claudere meant to shut or close; the root also gave close and claustrophobia.
items.cn: 拉丁语 claudere 意为关闭；同一词根还给了 close 与 claustrophobia。

items.en: in- plus claudere formed includere: to shut in, to enclose.
items.cn: in- 加 claudere 构成 includere：关入、围住。

items.en: In medieval use includere could mean to block in or to contain in writing.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语中 includere 可指围堵，也可指写进文中。

items.en: The word passed through Old French forms before reaching English.
items.cn: 该词经古法语形式传入英语。

items.en: Middle English includen first meant to enclose or shut in physically.
items.cn: 中古英语 includen 最初指物理上的围住、关住。

items.en: Modern English softened it to mean simply to have as a part.
items.cn: 现代英语将其弱化为「作为一部分而包含」。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the close-root family. The meaning group compares words about containing parts.
note.cn: 形近组收录含「关闭」词根的词族；词义组比较表示「包含部分」的词。

entries.definition: the noun for the act of including.

entries.definitionCN: 覆盖范围内一切的形容词。

entries.definition: to end or decide, from the same root claudere.
entries.definitionCN: 结束或下结论，同出于词根 claudere。

entries.definition: to hold inside, often about contents.
to make something a necessary part.
to consist of the listed parts.

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the shut-in root, the price phrase and the including trap.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩利用「关进去」的词根、价格短语与 including 的用法。

normal.en: in- plus claudere (close): shut something inside.
normal.cn: in- 加 claudere（关）：把东西关在里面。

normal.en: The price includes tax: the circle already holds it.
normal.cn: the price includes tax：圈里已经装着它。

normal.en: Conclusion and include share one root about closing.
normal.cn: conclusion 与 include 共享一个关于「关闭」的词根。

normal.en: Everyone was there, including the teacher: one pointing word.
normal.cn: including the teacher：一个指认全体的介词。

normal.en: Exclude is the twin: shut out instead of shut in.
normal.cn: exclude 是反义孪生词：关出去而非关进来。

abstract.en: One image: drawing a circle around toys so all belong.
abstract.cn: 只记一个画面：围着玩具画圈，圈内的都算数。

abstract.en: Include is an open door pulled inward.
abstract.cn: include 是一扇被往里拉开的门。

abstract.en: The bigger the circle, the more it includes.
abstract.cn: 圈越大，装得越多。

examples.en: The ticket price includes the museum tour.
examples.cn: 票价包含博物馆参观。

examples.en: Please include your name at the top of the form.
examples.cn: 请在表格顶部写上你的名字。

examples.en: Ten people came, including two new students.
examples.cn: 来了十个人，包括两名新生。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「隐克鲁德」：隐在克鲁德圈里的都被包含， include。

root: 拉丁语 in-「在内」+ claudere「关闭」→ includere「关入、围住」→ 古法语 → 中古英语 includen → 现代英语 include；同根词 conclude、disclose、closet。

sensesIntro.en: Include draws a circle: parts inside a whole, names inside a list, and the preposition that points at what the circle holds.
sensesIntro.cn: include 画一个圈：整体内的部分、名单内的名字，以及指向圈内内容的介词。

core.en: A drawn circle that makes whatever it holds count as part of the whole.
core.cn: 一个画出来的圈，圈住的东西都算整体的一部分。

branches.en: PARTHOOD: the price includes breakfast.
branches.cn: 整体与部分：价格含早餐。

branches.en: MEMBERSHIP: include me in the game.
branches.cn: 成员资格：把我也算进游戏。

branches.en: CONTENTS: the kit includes a screwdriver.
branches.cn: 内容物：工具包含螺丝刀。

branches.en: POINTING: including the teacher.
RANGE: what the circle takes in.

intro.en: Include builds included, including, inclusion and the opposite exclude.
intro.cn: include 构成 included、including、inclusion 及反义词 exclude。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries show the shutting root claudere and its family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁条目展示「关闭」词根 claudere 及其同族词。

items.example: Lunch is included in the fee.
Many cars passed, including a bus.
items.exampleCN: 许多车驶过，包括一辆巴士。

items.example: The fee is inclusive of meals.
The towels are in the closet.

definition_en: to become larger in amount or number, or the amount by which something grows
core_image: 温度计的水银柱慢慢往上升
scene: 城市年年盖起更多高楼。The number of visitors will increase this summer.
sceneCN: 这里 increase 是动词「增加」（第 1 个义项：数量变大）；句意：今年夏天游客数量将增加。

derivatives.zh: increase 加副词后缀，义为「越来越；日益」
increase 加过去分词后缀，义为「增加了的」
加反义前缀 de-，义为「减少」

senses.title: To grow larger in number
senses.definition: to become larger in amount, number or degree
senses.definitionCN: 在数量、数目或程度上变大
senses.example: Sales increased by twenty percent.
senses.exampleCN: 销量增长了百分之二十。
senses.why: A rising column on the meter shows the growth.
senses.whyCN: 仪表上不断升高的读数显示出增长。

senses.title: To make something larger
senses.definition: to cause something to become larger
senses.definitionCN: 使某物变大变多
senses.example: They increased the dose carefully.
senses.exampleCN: 他们谨慎地加大了剂量。
senses.why: A hand pushes the column higher on purpose.
senses.whyCN: 一只手刻意把读数推得更高。

senses.title: The amount of growth
senses.definition: the amount by which something has grown
senses.definitionCN: 某物增长的量
senses.example: There was a sharp increase in fares.
senses.why: The column rise itself gets a name.
senses.whyCN: 水银柱的上升本身也得了名字。

senses.title: Steady ongoing growth
senses.definition: growth that continues over time
senses.definitionCN: 随时间延续的增长
senses.example: The city has seen a steady increase in traffic.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市的交通量持续增长。
senses.why: The meter climbs season after season.
senses.whyCN: 仪表一季一季地攀升。

intro.en: Increase comes from Latin increscere, from in- (in, toward) + crescere (to grow). The picture is growth moving upward from inside.
intro.cn: increase 来自拉丁语 increscere，由 in-「向内」+ crescere「生长」构成，画面是自内而上的生长。

items.en: Latin crescere meant to grow, to spring up; it also gave crescent and crescendo.
items.cn: 拉丁语 crescere 意为生长、萌发；同根词还有 crescent 与 crescendo。

items.en: in- plus crescere formed increscere: to grow in, to grow toward.
items.cn: in- 加 crescere 构成 increscere：向内生长、逐渐增多。

items.en: The word passed through Old French increistre.
items.cn: 该词经古法语 increistre 传入。

items.en: Middle English encresen kept both the verb and the noun uses.
items.cn: 中古英语 encresen 同时保留动词与名词用法。

items.en: Modern English fixed the noun stress on the first syllable: an increase.
items.cn: 现代英语把名词重音固定在第一音节：an increase。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the grow-root family and its opposite. The meaning group compares words of rising numbers.
note.cn: 形近组收录「生长」词根词族及其反义词；词义组比较表示数量上升的词。

entries.definition: to become smaller, the direct antonym.
a gradual rise in sound, from the same Latin root.
entries.definitionCN: 声音渐强，同出拉丁词根。

entries.definition: spelling neighbor with a different origin.
to go up in level or amount.
to spread out to a larger size.

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the grow root, the percent phrase and the stress switch.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩利用「生长」词根、百分比短语与重音变化。

normal.en: in- plus crescere (grow): growth moving inward and upward.
normal.cn: in- 加 crescere（生长）：向内向上生长。

normal.en: Verb stress is IN-crease later; noun stress is IN-crease first: an increase.
normal.cn: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前：an increase。

normal.en: increase by ten percent is the exam favorite.
normal.cn: increase by ten percent 是考试常客。

normal.en: decrease is the twin with de- going down.
normal.cn: decrease 是带 de- 的下行孪生词。

normal.en: crescendo in music is the same idea of rising.
normal.cn: 音乐里的 crescendo 渐强是同一个上升概念。

abstract.en: One image: mercury climbing a thermometer.
abstract.cn: 只记一个画面：水银在温度计里攀升。

abstract.en: Every increase begins as one small seed of growth.
abstract.cn: 每次增长都始于一粒生长的种子。

abstract.en: Numbers are water: they rise when poured in.
abstract.cn: 数字像水：倒进去就上涨。

examples.en: House prices increased sharply last year.
examples.cn: 去年房价急剧上涨。

examples.en: We need to increase production to meet demand.
examples.cn: 我们需要增产以满足需求。

examples.en: There has been a big increase in online orders.
examples.cn: 线上订单大幅增长。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「因克瑞斯」：因为加了克数，瑞祥上升， increase。

root: 拉丁语 in-「向内」+ crescere「生长」→ increscere「逐渐增多」→ 古法语 increistre → 中古英语 encresen → 现代英语 increase；同根词 crescent、crescendo、decrease。

sensesIntro.en: Increase is the climbing meter: numbers going up, hands pushing them up, the rise itself, and growth that will not stop.
sensesIntro.cn: increase 是攀升的仪表：数字上涨、人手推升、上涨本身，以及不停歇的增长。

core.en: A rising column that measures growth in numbers, size and force.
core.cn: 一根不断升高的读数柱，量出数量、规模与力度的增长。

branches.en: NUMBERS: sales increased by twenty percent.
ACTION: they increased the dose.
MEASURE: a sharp increase in fares.
TREND: a steady increase in traffic.
SCALE: growth measured over time.
branches.cn: 规模：随时间量出的增长。

intro.en: Increase builds increased, increasing, increasingly and its twin decrease.
intro.cn: increase 构成 increased、increasing、increasingly 及孪生词 decrease。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries show the growth verb crescere behind the family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁条目展示词族背后的生长动词 crescere。

items.example: A crescent hung in the sky.

definition_en: the state of being free from control by others or by another country
core_image: 剪断的提线：木偶不再被拉扯
scene: 国庆日广场上，孩子们放飞自己扎的风筝。The country celebrates its independence every July.
sceneCN: 这里 independence 是「独立」（第 1 个义项：不受他人控制的状态）；句意：这个国家每年七月庆祝独立。

derivatives.zh: independence 的形容词形式，义为「独立的；自主的」
independent 加副词后缀，义为「独立地」
去掉否定前缀后的名词，义为「依赖」

senses.title: Freedom from outside control
senses.definition: the state of being free from control by another person, group or country
senses.definitionCN: 不受他人、组织或别国控制的状态
senses.example: The colony won independence after a long struggle.
senses.exampleCN: 殖民地经过长期斗争赢得独立。
senses.why: The puppet strings are cut and the figure stands alone.
senses.whyCN: 提线剪断，木偶独自站立。

senses.title: Personal self-reliance
senses.definition: the ability to act and decide for oneself
senses.definitionCN: 自己行动、自己决定的能力
senses.example: Living alone taught her independence.
senses.why: One wire at a time is cut until the puppet moves on its own.
senses.whyCN: 提线一根根剪断，直到木偶能自己动。

senses.title: Financial self-support
senses.definition: having enough money not to depend on others
senses.definitionCN: 有足够的钱而不必依赖他人
senses.example: A part-time job gave him financial independence.
senses.exampleCN: 兼职让他实现了经济独立。
senses.why: The strings of the purse are cut too.
senses.whyCN: 钱袋上的线也被剪断了。

senses.title: Independence Day
senses.definition: a national holiday marking a country's independence
senses.definitionCN: 纪念国家独立的节日
senses.example: Fireworks marked Independence Day.
senses.why: The cut is remembered as a feast.
senses.whyCN: 那次剪断被当作节日纪念。

intro.en: Independence is depend with in- (not) and the noun ending -ence. Depend itself comes from Latin de- (down) + pendere (to hang): to hang from something.
intro.cn: independence 由 depend 加否定前缀 in- 与名词后缀 -ence 构成。depend 出自拉丁语 de-「向下」+ pendere「悬挂」，本义是「挂在某物上」。

items.en: Latin pendere meant to hang; scales hung and weighed.
items.cn: 拉丁语 pendere 意为悬挂；天平悬起称量。

items.en: de- plus pendere formed dependere: to hang down from.
items.cn: de- 加 pendere 构成 dependere：从……垂挂下来。

items.en: Old French dependre carried the idea of hanging upon.
items.cn: 古法语 dependre 保留「悬挂于上」之意。

items.en: Middle English dependen meant to hang down, then to rely on.
items.cn: 中古英语 dependen 先指垂下，后指依赖。

items.en: English added in- and -ence to name the state of not hanging on anyone.
items.cn: 英语加上 in- 与 -ence，命名不依附任何人的状态。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the hang-root family. The meaning group compares words of standing free.
note.cn: 形近组收录「悬挂」词根词族；词义组比较表示独立自主的词。

entries.definition: the adjective of the same family.
the state of relying on others.
to hang up, from the same pendere.
the general power to act as one wishes.
entries.definitionCN: 按自己意愿行动的普遍能力。

entries.definition: self-rule of a group or person.

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the hanging root, the cut-strings image and the holiday name.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩利用「悬挂」词根、剪线意象与节日名称。

normal.en: de-pend: hang down; in-dependence: not hanging on anyone.
normal.cn: depend 是垂挂；independence 是不挂在任何人身上。

normal.en: Independence Day is the national birthday.
normal.cn: 独立日是国家的生日。

normal.en: gain independence is the standard phrase for new countries.
normal.cn: gain independence 是新国家获得独立的固定说法。

normal.en: declare independence echoes the famous declaration.
normal.cn: declare independence 呼应著名的《独立宣言》。

normal.en: dependence is the twin that still hangs.
normal.cn: dependence 是还在垂挂的孪生词。

abstract.en: One image: a puppet whose strings fall cut to the floor.
abstract.cn: 只记一个画面：木偶的提线齐齐断落在地。

abstract.en: Independence is the moment you stop borrowing legs.
abstract.cn: 独立是不再借腿走路的那一刻。

abstract.en: A country standing on its own feet, like a person.
abstract.cn: 国家像人一样自己站稳。

examples.en: India gained independence in nineteen forty-seven.
examples.cn: 印度于一九四七年获得独立。

examples.en: She values her independence above everything.
examples.cn: 她把独立看得高于一切。

examples.en: The village declared its independence from the old system.
examples.cn: 村庄宣布脱离旧体制而独立。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「因迪潘登斯」：不再「等」着别人「攀登」，自己站起来， independence。

root: 拉丁语 de-「向下」+ pendere「悬挂」→ dependere「垂挂」→ 古法语/中古英语 depend「依赖」→ 加否定前缀 in- 与名词后缀 -ence 得 independence「不依赖的状态」。

sensesIntro.en: Independence is the cut string: a nation free from a ruler, a person free to decide, a wallet free of debt, and the holiday that remembers the cut.
sensesIntro.cn: independence 是剪断的线：国家摆脱统治者、个人自己做主、钱包不再欠债，以及纪念那一剪的节日。

core.en: Cut strings: standing without being hung or pulled by anyone.
core.cn: 剪断的提线：不被任何人悬挂或牵引地站立。

branches.en: NATIONHOOD: the colony won independence.
branches.cn: 国家层面：殖民地赢得独立。

branches.en: SELFHOOD: living alone taught her independence.
branches.cn: 个人层面：独居教会她自立。

branches.en: MONEY: financial independence from a job.
branches.cn: 经济层面：兼职带来经济独立。

branches.en: MEMORY: fireworks on Independence Day.
STANDING: free to act without pull.

intro.en: Independence builds its adjective independent and the opposite dependence.
intro.cn: independence 派生出形容词 independent 及反义名词 dependence。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries show the hanging verb pendere behind the family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁条目展示词族背后的悬挂动词 pendere。

definition_zh: 独立的；自主的；不依赖的
definition_en: not relying on others for support, control or decisions; free and self-governing
core_image: 自己骑车不扶把手的人
scene: 少年第一次独自骑车穿过街口。She became an independent traveler after college.
sceneCN: 这里 independent 是「自主的」（第 2 个义项：自己的事自己决定）；句意：大学毕业后她成了独自旅行的旅人。

derivatives.zh: independent 加副词后缀，义为「独立地」
同族名词，义为「独立；自主」
反义名词，义为「依赖」

senses.title: Free from outside control
senses.definition: not governed or controlled by another power
senses.definitionCN: 不受另一权力统治或控制
senses.example: It became an independent nation.
senses.exampleCN: 它成了一个独立的国家。
senses.why: The flag stands for no hand above it.
senses.whyCN: 这面旗帜之上再无别手。

senses.title: Deciding for oneself
senses.definition: making your own decisions without help
senses.definitionCN: 无需帮助自己作决定
senses.example: She is old enough to be independent.
senses.exampleCN: 她已到了能自主的年纪。
senses.why: The rider lets go of the handlebars.
senses.whyCN: 骑车人松开了扶手。

senses.title: Not relying on money or support
senses.definition: earning your own living without help
senses.definitionCN: 自食其力，无需接济
senses.example: He is independent of his parents now.
senses.why: The wallet feeds itself.
senses.whyCN: 钱包自己养活自己。

senses.title: Separate and unconnected
senses.definition: not connected with or influenced by something else
senses.definitionCN: 不与他物关联或受其影响
senses.example: The two studies reached independent conclusions.
senses.exampleCN: 两项研究得出了互不影响的结论。
senses.why: Two clocks tick without touching each other.
senses.whyCN: 两只钟各自走针，互不相触。

senses.title: A person of no party
senses.definition: a politician or voter not belonging to a party
senses.definitionCN: 不属于任何党派的政治人物或选民
senses.example: An independent won the seat this time.
senses.exampleCN: 这次一位无党派人士赢得了席位。
senses.why: No flag, only the person's own name.
senses.whyCN: 不举旗，只署本人的名字。

intro.en: Independent is depend with in- (not) and -ent. The Latin root pendere means to hang; to be independent is not to hang from anyone.
intro.cn: independent 由 depend 加否定前缀 in- 与形容词后缀 -ent 构成。拉丁词根 pendere 意为悬挂；independent 即不挂在任何人身上。

items.en: Latin pendere meant to hang; payments once hung from the giver.
items.cn: 拉丁语 pendere 意为悬挂；付账本像挂在付钱人身上。

items.en: de- plus pendere formed dependere: to hang down, then to rely.
items.cn: de- 加 pendere 构成 dependere：垂挂，引申为依赖。

items.en: Medieval Latin dependentem described one who hangs on another.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 dependentem 描述依附他人者。

items.en: Old French dependant passed the word on.
items.cn: 古法语 dependant 继续传承该词。

items.en: Middle English added in- to make independent, not hanging.
items.cn: 中古英语加上 in-，构成 independent「不悬挂的」。

items.en: Modern English extended it from people to nations and studies.
items.cn: 现代英语把它从人扩展到国家与研究。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the hang-root family. The meaning group compares words for standing alone.
note.cn: 形近组收录「悬挂」词根词族；词义组比较表示独自站立的词。

entries.definition: the noun of the same family.

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the hanging root, the voter use and the be independent of pattern.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩利用「悬挂」词根、无党派用法与 be independent of 句式。

normal.en: in- means not; dependent means hanging: not hanging.
normal.cn: in- 表否定，dependent 表悬挂：不悬挂。

normal.en: be independent of is the fixed pattern.
normal.cn: be independent of 是固定句式。

normal.en: An independent voter belongs to no party.
normal.cn: 无党派选民不属于任何党派。

normal.en: pendulum and suspend share the swinging-hang root.
normal.cn: pendulum 与 suspend 共享悬挂摆动的词根。

normal.en: dependent is the twin still hanging on.
normal.cn: dependent 是还挂着的孪生词。

abstract.en: One image: a rider letting go of the handlebars.
abstract.cn: 只记一个画面：骑车人松开扶手。

abstract.en: Independent is your own flag with your own name.
abstract.cn: independent 是只署自己名字的旗。

abstract.en: Two clocks that never touch still keep true time.
abstract.cn: 互不相触的两只钟照样走准时间。

examples.en: The country has been independent since nineteen sixty.
examples.cn: 该国自一九六零年起独立。

examples.en: She is an independent woman with her own business.
examples.cn: 她是拥有自己事业的独立女性。

examples.en: The findings were confirmed by independent researchers.
examples.cn: 研究结果得到独立研究者的证实。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「因迪潘登特」：不用「等」人「攀登」，自己登顶， independent。

root: 拉丁语 de-「向下」+ pendere「悬挂」→ dependere「垂挂、依赖」→ 拉丁/古法语 dependent「依附的」→ 加否定前缀 in- 得 independent「不依赖的」。

sensesIntro.en: Independent is the loosened hand: free nations, free decisions, self-fed wallets, unlinked studies, and voters under no flag.
sensesIntro.cn: independent 是松开的手：自由国家、自己做主、自食其力、互不牵连的研究，以及不举旗的选民。

core.en: Standing without hanging: nothing above pulls or feeds you.
core.cn: 不悬挂地站立：没有东西在上面牵引或喂养你。

branches.en: NATIONHOOD: an independent nation.
DECISION: old enough to be independent.
branches.cn: 决定：到了能自主的年纪。

branches.en: SUPPORT: independent of his parents.
UNLINKED: independent conclusions.
branches.cn: 互不牵连：互不影响的结论。

branches.en: NEUTRALITY: an independent won the seat.
branches.cn: 中立：无党派者赢得席位。

intro.en: Independent builds independently, independence and the opposite dependent.
intro.cn: independent 构成 independently、independence 及反义词 dependent。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries show the hanging verb behind the whole family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁条目展示整个词族背后的悬挂动词。

items.example: An independent judge heard the case.
items.exampleCN: 一位独立法官审理此案。

items.example: Append a note to the report.

definition_en: into or inside a building; within a house
core_image: 从门口走进屋檐的那一步
scene: 外面下起大雨，猫第一个溜进了屋里。The children stayed indoors all afternoon.
sceneCN: 这里 indoors 是「在室内」（第 1 个义项：处于屋内）；句意：孩子们整个下午都待在室内。

derivatives.zh: 反义副词，义为「在户外」
去 s 的形容词，义为「室内的」
反义形容词，义为「户外的」

senses.title: Within a building
senses.definition: inside a house or building
senses.definitionCN: 在房屋或建筑物里面
senses.example: Stay indoors until the storm passes.
senses.exampleCN: 暴风雨过去之前请待在室内。
senses.why: The roof above is the whole map.
senses.whyCN: 头顶的屋顶就是全部地图。

senses.title: Into a building
senses.definition: moving from outside to inside
senses.definitionCN: 从外面走进里面
senses.example: Everyone hurried indoors when it rained.
senses.exampleCN: 下雨时大家匆匆进了屋。
senses.why: One step across the doorway.
senses.whyCN: 跨过门槛的一步。

senses.title: Opposite of outdoors
senses.definition: the word paired against outdoor life
senses.definitionCN: 与户外生活相对的词
senses.example: He prefers indoors to the hot sun.
senses.exampleCN: 比起烈日他更愿意待在室内。
senses.why: Inside and outside stand face to face.
senses.whyCN: 屋内与屋外面对面。

intro.en: Indoors is a compound of in + doors, formed in English. The odd plural is a fossil: the word came from the phrase within doors.
intro.cn: indoors 是英语内造的复合词，由 in + doors 构成。复数形式是化石：它来自短语 within doors「在门之内」。

items.en: Old English duru meant door; its plural became doors.
items.cn: 古英语 duru 意为门，复数为 doors。

items.en: The phrase within doors meant inside the house's doors.
items.cn: 短语 within doors 指屋门之内。

items.en: A shorter form at doors also meant inside.
items.cn: 更简的形式 at doors 同样指在屋内。

items.en: English fused in with doors into the adverb indoors.
items.cn: 现代英语把 in 与 doors 融合成副词 indoors。

items.en: Later the adjective indoor dropped the s by analogy with outdoor.
items.cn: 后来类比 outdoor，形容词 indoor 去掉了 s。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the door family. The meaning group compares words of being inside.
note.cn: 形近组收录 door 词族；词义组比较表示「在内」的词。

entries.definitionCN: 不带 s 的形容词。

entries.definition: in the inner part of something.

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the within-doors origin, the storm phrase and the outdoor pair.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩利用 within doors 词源、暴风雨句式与户外配对。

normal.en: indoors literally kept its old plural: in + doors.
normal.cn: indoors 字面保留了古复数：in + doors。

normal.en: stay indoors before the storm.
normal.cn: 暴风雨来临前 stay indoors。

normal.en: indoor pool drops the s: the adjective is singular.
normal.cn: indoor pool 去掉 s：形容词用单数形。

normal.en: outdoors is the mirror word.
normal.cn: outdoors 是镜子里的词。

normal.en: within doors was the original long phrase.
normal.cn: within doors 是原来的长说法。

abstract.en: One image: a raindrop stopping at the doorstep.
abstract.cn: 只记一个画面：雨滴停在门槛外。

abstract.en: Indoors is the warm side of a doorway.
abstract.cn: indoors 是门口温暖的那一侧。

abstract.en: The roof is the ceiling of your world indoors.
abstract.cn: 在室内，屋顶就是你世界的天花板。

examples.en: It was too cold, so we stayed indoors.
examples.cn: 天太冷，我们就待在室内。

examples.en: Bring the cat indoors before dark.
examples.cn: 天黑前把猫带进屋。

examples.en: The pool is outdoors but the gym is indoors.
examples.cn: 泳池在室外，健身房在室内。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「因 doors」：因下雨，赶紧进门（doors）， indoors。

root: 英语短语 within doors / at doors「门之内」→ 压缩融合为复合副词 indoors「在室内」；与 outdoor 类比得形容词 indoor。

sensesIntro.en: Indoors is the doorway step: being under a roof, crossing in from the rain, and the mirror word outdoors.
sensesIntro.cn: indoors 是门槛上那一步：在屋顶之下、从雨里跨进屋，以及镜子对面的 outdoors。

core.en: The warm side of the doorway: under a roof instead of the sky.
core.cn: 门口温暖的一侧：在屋顶下而非天底下。

branches.en: SHELTER: stay indoors until the storm passes.
branches.cn: 庇护：暴风雨过去前待在屋内。

branches.en: CROSSING: everyone hurried indoors.
CONTRAST: indoors against the hot sun.
INTERIOR: life inside the doors.
PAIRING: indoors and outdoors.

intro.en: Indoors pairs with indoor, outdoors and outdoor in one door family.
intro.cn: indoors 与 indoor、outdoors、outdoor 同属一个门字词族。

latinIntro.en: No Latin entries: this compound is pure English.
latinIntro.cn: 无拉丁条目：该复合词是纯正英语造词。

definition_en: the business of making goods in factories, a branch of trade, or hard steady work
core_image: 轰鸣的流水线：原料进去，产品出来
scene: 河边的新厂区里机器连成一片。The car industry employs thousands of workers.
sceneCN: 这里 industry 是「行业」（第 2 个义项：某类产业）；句意：汽车行业雇用数千名工人。

derivatives.zh: industry 加形容词后缀，义为「工业的」
industrial 加动词后缀，义为「工业化」
同根形容词，义为「勤奋的」

senses.title: Manufacturing as a whole
senses.definition: the production of goods in factories
senses.definitionCN: 在工厂里生产商品的活动
senses.example: The region depends on heavy industry.
senses.why: A whole plain of chimneys makes the goods.
senses.whyCN: 一整片烟囱造出商品。

senses.title: A branch of trade
senses.definition: one particular line of business
senses.definitionCN: 某一类经营活动
senses.example: The tourist industry grew fast.
senses.why: One belt of the great machine is named after its goods.
senses.whyCN: 大机器的一条带子以它的商品命名。

senses.title: Hard steady work
senses.definition: working hard and steadily
senses.definitionCN: 努力而持续地工作
senses.example: Her industry impressed the teacher.
senses.exampleCN: 她的勤奋给老师留下深刻印象。
senses.why: The factory never stops, and neither does the worker.
senses.whyCN: 工厂不停，工人也不停。

senses.title: Industrial companies collectively
senses.definition: the companies and people who run factories
senses.definitionCN: 经营工厂的公司与人群
senses.example: Industry has asked for lower taxes.
senses.why: All chimneys speak with one voice.
senses.whyCN: 所有烟囱用一个声音说话。

intro.en: Industry comes from Latin industria, meaning diligence, built on indu- (within) and the root ofstruere (to build up). The meaning shifted from hard work to organized production.
intro.cn: industry 来自拉丁语 industria「勤奋」，由 indu-「在内」与词根 struere「建造」构成；词义从辛勤劳作转移到有组织的生产。

items.en: Latin struere meant to build, pile up; it gave structure and construct.
items.cn: 拉丁语 struere 意为建造、堆积；同根词有 structure 与 construct。

items.en: industria meant diligence, a constant building-up of effort.
items.cn: 拉丁语 industria 意为勤勉，即持续积累的努力。

items.en: Old French industrie carried the sense of ability and activity.
items.cn: 古法语 industrie 带有才能与活动之意。

items.en: Middle English industrie first meant cleverness and diligence.
items.cn: 中古英语 industrie 最初指机敏与勤勉。

items.en: The industrial revolution gave it the factory sense we use most today.
items.cn: 工业革命赋予它今天最常用的工厂含义。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the build-root family. The meaning group compares words of trade and work.
note.cn: 形近组收录「建造」词根词族；词义组比较表示行业与劳作的词。

entries.definition: the adjective of the same family.
trade in general or one firm.
the activity of buying and selling.

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the build root, the factory sense and the industrious twin.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩利用「建造」词根、工厂义与 industrious 孪生词。

normal.en: in- plus struere (build): effort built up inside a person.
normal.cn: in- 加 struere（建造）：人内心垒起的努力。

normal.en: structure and construct share the same build root.
normal.cn: structure 与 construct 共享同一建造词根。

normal.en: the tourist industry: one belt of the machine.
normal.cn: the tourist industry：大机器的一条带子。

normal.en: industrious kept the old meaning of hard work.
normal.cn: industrious 保留了辛勤工作的旧义。

normal.en: the industrial revolution renamed the word.
normal.cn: 工业革命重新命名了这个词。

abstract.en: One image: a chimney plain breathing smoke in rows.
abstract.cn: 只记一个画面：烟囱成排，呼出白烟。

abstract.en: Industry is effort piled up until it becomes a trade.
abstract.cn: industry 是垒起来的努力，垒到成了行业。

abstract.en: The worker and the factory share one heartbeat.
abstract.cn: 工人与工厂共享同一个心跳。

examples.en: Steel industry moved the whole town forward.
examples.cn: 钢铁工业带动了整个小镇。

examples.en: The fashion industry sets trends each season.
examples.cn: 时尚业每季引领潮流。

examples.en: Success needs talent and industry together.
examples.cn: 成功需要天赋与勤奋兼备。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「因达斯特里」：在达城里辛勤开工厂， industry。

root: 拉丁语 indu-「在内」+ struere「建造」→ industria「勤勉」→ 古法语 industrie「才能、活动」→ 中古英语 industrie「勤勉」→ 现代英语增加「工业、行业」义；同根词 structure、construct、instrument。

sensesIntro.en: Industry is the endless machine: the whole of manufacturing, one named trade, the diligence behind it, and the voice of all factories.
sensesIntro.cn: industry 是不歇的机器：制造业整体、被命名的某一行业、背后的勤奋，以及所有工厂的合唱。

core.en: Effort built up like a wall until it becomes a whole machine of production.
core.cn: 努力像砌墙般层层垒起，直到成为整套生产机器。

branches.en: MANUFACTURE: the region depends on heavy industry.
branches.cn: 制造：该地区依靠重工业。

branches.en: TRADE: the tourist industry grew fast.
DILIGENCE: her industry impressed the teacher.
branches.cn: 勤勉：她的勤奋令人印象深刻。

branches.en: VOICE: industry has asked for lower taxes.
SCALE: production measured in whole trades.
branches.cn: 规模：以整条行业计量的生产。

intro.en: Industry builds industrial, industrialize and industrious.
intro.cn: industry 构成 industrial、industrialize 与 industrious。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries show the building verb struere behind the family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁条目展示词族背后的建造动词 struere。

items.example: An industrial zone lies east of the city.
The bridge has a steel structure.

definition_en: the power to change how someone acts or thinks without using force
core_image: 看不见的风把树叶吹向一侧
scene: 老师随口的一句评语，让少年重新拿起了画笔。Parents have a strong influence on children.
sceneCN: 这里 influence 是「影响」（第 1 个义项：改变他人的力量）；句意：父母对孩子有很大影响。

derivatives.zh: influence 加形容词后缀，义为「有影响力的」
influence 加施动者后缀，义为「网红；有影响的人」
同源词，义为「流感」（旧义「星象影响」）

senses.title: Power to change others
senses.definition: the power to change how someone acts or thinks without force
senses.definitionCN: 不用强力就能改变他人行动或想法的力量
senses.example: Parents have a strong influence on children.
senses.exampleCN: 父母对孩子有很大影响。
senses.why: An unseen wind bends the leaves.
senses.whyCN: 看不见的风吹弯了树叶。

senses.title: A person or thing that shapes
senses.titleCN: 影响者；产生影响的事物
senses.definition: someone or something that shapes another
senses.definitionCN: 塑造他人的人或事物
senses.example: That book was a great influence in her life.
senses.exampleCN: 那本书对她一生影响极大。
senses.why: The wind itself gets a name.
senses.whyCN: 这阵风本身也有了名字。

senses.title: To sway or shape
senses.definition: to change someone's behavior or a result quietly
senses.definitionCN: 悄悄改变某人的行为或某个结果
senses.example: Advertising influences what we buy.
senses.exampleCN: 广告左右着我们的购买。
senses.why: The wind is released at the leaves.
senses.whyCN: 风被释放到树叶上。

senses.title: Under the influence: drunk
senses.definition: affected by alcohol, a fixed legal phrase
senses.definitionCN: 受酒精作用，法律固定短语
senses.example: He was arrested for driving under the influence.
senses.why: The wind inside the bottle steers the car.
senses.whyCN: 瓶中的风替他掌了方向盘。

intro.en: Influence comes from medieval Latin influentia, a flowing in. Astrologers first used it for an invisible fluid said to flow from the stars into people, shaping their fates.
intro.cn: influence 来自中世纪拉丁语 influentia「流入」。占星家先用它指从星辰流入人体、左右命运的不可见流体。

items.en: Latin fluere meant to flow; it gave fluid, fluent and fluent rivers of words.
items.cn: 拉丁语 fluere 意为流动；同根词有 fluid、fluent 等。

items.en: in- plus fluere formed influere: to flow in.
items.cn: in- 加 fluere 构成 influere：流入。

items.en: influentia named the star-fluid that shaped human fate.
items.cn: influentia 指塑造人命运的星辰流体。

items.en: Old French influence passed the astrological sense to English.
items.cn: 古法语 influence 把占星义传给英语。

items.en: Modern English dropped the stars and kept the invisible shaping power.
items.cn: 现代英语去掉了星辰，只留下那股无形的塑造之力。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the flow-root family. The meaning group compares words of quiet power.
note.cn: 形近组收录「流动」词根词族；词义组比较表示无形力量的词。

entries.definition: flu; from the same flowing-in idea.

entries.definitionCN: 流利的，同样出自流动词根。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the star-fluid origin, the flow root and the legal phrase.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩利用星辰流体词源、流动词根与法律短语。

normal.en: in- plus fluere (flow): an invisible current flows in.
normal.cn: in- 加 fluere（流动）：一股看不见的水流流入。

normal.en: Astrologers thought star-fluid shaped your fate.
normal.cn: 占星家认为星辰流体塑造命运。

normal.en: have an influence on is the exam pattern.
normal.cn: have an influence on 是考试句式。

normal.en: driving under the influence means drunk driving.
normal.cn: driving under the influence 即酒驾。

normal.en: influent people and influencer share the root.
normal.cn: influential 与 influencer 共享词根。

abstract.en: One image: wind that no eye sees bending every leaf.
abstract.cn: 只记一个画面：无人看见的风吹弯了每片叶子。

abstract.en: Influence is force without a push.
abstract.cn: influence 是不用推搡的力量。

abstract.en: A river entering a lake quietly changes its color.
abstract.cn: 一条河悄悄入湖，改变了湖水的颜色。

examples.en: Teachers have a lasting influence on students.
examples.cn: 老师对学生有持久的影响。

examples.en: The moon influences the tides.
examples.cn: 月亮影响潮汐。

examples.en: He was charged with driving under the influence.
examples.cn: 他被控酒后驾驶。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「因fluence（富润斯）」：富人有润物无声的影响力， influence。

root: 拉丁语 in-「流入」+ fluere「流动」→ 中世纪拉丁语 influentia「星辰流入人体的流体」→ 古法语 influence → 现代英语 influence「无形的影响」；同根词 fluid、fluent、fluctuate。

sensesIntro.en: Influence is the star-fluid turned everyday: a power that flows in, the person carrying it, the quiet act of shaping, and the bottle that steers a car.
sensesIntro.cn: influence 是走进日常的星辰流体：流入的力量、携风之人、悄然塑造的动作，以及替人掌舵的酒瓶。

core.en: An invisible current that flows in and bends what it touches.
core.cn: 一股看不见的水流，流入并使所触之物弯曲。

branches.en: POWER: parents shape children.
AGENT: the book was a great influence.
branches.cn: 影响者：那本书影响极大。

branches.en: ACTION: advertising influences what we buy.
INTOXICATION: driving under the influence.
SHAPING: fate bent without force.
branches.cn: 塑造：命运不经强力而被改变。

intro.en: Influence builds influential, influencer and keeps influenza in the family.
intro.cn: influence 构成 influential、influencer， influenza 亦属同族。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries show the flowing verb fluere behind the family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁条目展示词族背后的流动动词 fluere。

items.exampleCN: 一篇有影响的论文改变了政策。

latinEntries.meaning: a flowing in; star-fluid shaping fate
latinEntries.meaningCN: 流入；左右命运的星辰流体

definition_en: facts or knowledge that tell you something about a subject or situation
core_image: 邮差把一份份写好的纸送进大脑
scene: 车站里游客围着戴红帽的问询员。For more information, please call this number.
sceneCN: 这里 information 是「信息」（第 1 个义项：告知某事的事实）；句意：欲知详情，请拨打此号码。

derivatives.zh: information 的动词基，义为「通知；告知」
inform 加形容词后缀，义为「信息量大的」
inform 加施动者后缀，义为「告密者」

senses.title: Facts that tell something
senses.definition: facts or knowledge communicated about something
senses.definitionCN: 传达某事的事实或知识
senses.example: The leaflet gives useful information.
senses.exampleCN: 这本小册子提供了有用的信息。
senses.why: Written sheets are carried into the mind.
senses.whyCN: 写好的纸被送进脑海。

senses.title: Data processed by computers
senses.definition: data stored or processed by machines
senses.definitionCN: 由机器存储或处理的数据
senses.example: The database stores patient information.
senses.why: The postman becomes a wire.
senses.whyCN: 邮差变成了一根电线。

senses.title: An office that answers questions
senses.definition: a desk or office that gives answers to the public
senses.definitionCN: 向公众答疑的台子或办公室
senses.example: Ask at the information desk.
senses.why: The man behind the desk holds all the sheets.
senses.whyCN: 台后的人握着所有的纸。

senses.title: Formal charges against someone
senses.definition: an official statement accusing a person of a crime
senses.definitionCN: 指控某人犯罪的具体陈词
senses.example: Police laid an information against him.
senses.exampleCN: 警方对他提出正式指控。
senses.why: The sheet is handed to a judge instead.
senses.whyCN: 那张纸这次递给了法官。

intro.en: Information comes from Latin informare, to give shape to, built on in- (into) and formare (to form). Knowledge was thought of as shape pressed into the mind.
intro.cn: information 来自拉丁语 informare「赋形」，由 in-「进入」+ formare「成形」构成；知识被视为压进脑海的形状。

items.en: Latin formare meant to shape or mold; forma meant a figure.
items.cn: 拉丁语 formare 意为塑造；forma 指形状。

items.en: in- plus formare formed informare: to shape into, to instruct.
items.cn: in- 加 formare 构成 informare：注入形状，即教导。

items.en: Latin informatio named both instruction and the shape of an idea.
items.cn: 拉丁语 informatio 兼指教学与观念的成形。

items.en: Middle English informacioun meant instruction and news alike.
items.cn: 中古英语 informacioun 兼指教导与消息。

items.en: Modern English made it uncountable and added the computer sense.
items.cn: 现代英语使其不可数，并增加了计算机义。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the form-root family. The meaning group compares words of knowledge and news.
note.cn: 形近组收录「成形」词根词族；词义组比较表示知识与消息的词。

entries.definition: the verb of the same family.

entries.definitionCN: 你所理解与掌握的东西。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the shape root, the uncountable rule and the desk use.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩利用「成形」词根、不可数规则与问讯处用法。

normal.en: in- plus formare: shape pressed into the mind.
normal.cn: in- 加 formare：把形状压进脑海。

normal.en: information is uncountable: a piece of information.
normal.cn: information 不可数：要说 a piece of information。

normal.en: the information desk answers questions.
normal.cn: the information desk 负责答疑。

normal.en: IT means information technology.
normal.cn: IT 即信息技术。

normal.en: form and formation share the shape root.
normal.cn: form 与 formation 共享成形词根。

abstract.en: One image: letters folding themselves into the head like paper planes.
abstract.cn: 只记一个画面：字纸折成飞机飞进头脑。

abstract.en: Information is shape given to what was fog.
abstract.cn: information 是给迷雾赋形。

abstract.en: The mind is a desk where every sheet is filed.
abstract.cn: 头脑是一张把每张纸都归档的桌子。

examples.en: This website provides travel information for free.
examples.cn: 这个网站免费提供旅行信息。

examples.en: Never share your personal information online.
examples.cn: 切勿在网上泄露个人信息。

examples.en: She informed us of the change in schedule.
examples.cn: 她把我们日程的变动通知了我们。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「因福美申」：因消息带来福，美事申明于众， information。

root: 拉丁语 in-「进入」+ formare「成形」→ informare「教导、赋形」→ informatio → 中古英语 informacioun → 现代英语 information；同根词 form、formation、formal。

sensesIntro.en: Information is shape delivered: facts sent to the mind, data sent to machines, a desk that answers, and a sheet that accuses.
sensesIntro.cn: information 是被递送的形状：送到脑海的事实、送进机器的数据、答疑的台子，以及一张递给法官的指控书。

core.en: Shape pressed into a receiver: mind, machine, desk or court.
core.cn: 压进接收者的形状：脑海、机器、问讯台或法庭。

branches.en: KNOWLEDGE: the leaflet gives useful information.
branches.cn: 知识：小册子提供有用信息。

branches.en: DATA: the database stores patient information.
branches.cn: 数据：数据库存病人信息。

branches.en: SERVICE: ask at the information desk.
ACCUSATION: police laid an information.
branches.cn: 指控：警方提出正式指控。

branches.en: DELIVERY: shape carried from sender to receiver.
branches.cn: 递送：形状从发送方到接收方。

intro.en: Information builds inform, informative, informer and informality of form words.
intro.cn: information 构成 inform、informative、informer，并与 form 词族相关。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries show the shaping verb formare behind the family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁条目展示词族背后的成形动词 formare。

items.exampleCN: 内容翔实的讲座吸引了许多人。

definition_en: one of the foods or things that are combined to make something
core_image: 案板上摆开的一排待下锅的材料
scene: 妈妈把鸡蛋、面粉和糖依次排开。Flour is the main ingredient of bread.
sceneCN: 这里 ingredient 是「原料」（第 1 个义项：混合物的组成部分）；句意：面粉是面包的主要原料。

derivatives.zh: 罕见同源词，义为「共同成分」（极罕用）
少见副词形式（极罕用）

senses.title: A food that goes into a dish
senses.definition: one of the foods used to make a dish
senses.definitionCN: 做菜所用食材之一
senses.example: Add the other ingredients slowly.
senses.why: Each item waits on the board before the pot.
senses.whyCN: 每样食材在下锅前先在案板上列队。

senses.title: A part of a mixture or medicine
senses.definition: one substance in a mixture or product
senses.definitionCN: 混合物或产品中的一种物质
senses.example: The active ingredient fights the pain.
senses.why: One powder inside the pill does the work.
senses.whyCN: 药丸里的某一味粉末起作用。

senses.title: A quality needed for a result
senses.definition: one quality that helps produce an outcome
senses.definitionCN: 促成某一结果所需的一种品质
senses.example: Trust is the key ingredient of friendship.
senses.exampleCN: 信任是友谊的关键要素。
senses.why: The recipe is lifted out of the kitchen.
senses.whyCN: 配方被从厨房里 lifted 出来用于人生。

intro.en: Ingredient is the present participle of Latin ingredi, to step into or enter, from in- (into) and gradi (to step). Each ingredient is something that steps into the pot.
intro.cn: ingredient 是拉丁语 ingredi「走入」的现在分词，由 in-「进入」+ gradi「迈步」构成；每种配料都是走进锅里的东西。

items.en: Latin gradi meant to step, to walk; gradi gave grade and gradual.
items.cn: 拉丁语 gradi 意为迈步；同根词有 grade 与 gradual。

items.en: in- plus gradi formed ingredi: to step into, to enter.
items.cn: in- 加 gradi 构成 ingredi：走入、进入。

items.en: ingrediens described a thing stepping in as part of a whole.
items.cn: ingrediens 描述正走入整体之内的事物。

items.en: Medieval Latin ingredientem named a component in medicine and alchemy.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 ingredientem 指医药与炼金中的成分。

items.en: English kept the kitchen sense and added the quality sense.
items.cn: 现代英语保留厨房义，并增加品质义。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the step-root family. The meaning group compares words of parts and components.
note.cn: 形近组收录「迈步」词根词族；词义组比较表示组成部分的词。

entries.definition: a working part of a machine or system.
entries.definitionCN: 机器或系统的组成部件。

entries.definition: a basic part of a whole.
a necessary part of a larger thing.
entries.definitionCN: 更大之物不可缺少的部分。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the stepping-in root, the recipe shelf and the quality sense.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩利用「走入」词根、食谱货架与品质义。

normal.en: in- plus gradi (step): each item steps into the pot.
normal.cn: in- 加 gradi（迈步）：每种食材走进锅里。

normal.en: grade and gradual share the stepping root.
normal.cn: grade 与 gradual 共享迈步词根。

normal.en: the main ingredient is what the dish leans on.
normal.cn: the main ingredient 是菜品的依靠。

normal.en: active ingredient appears on every medicine box.
normal.cn: active ingredient 印在每个药盒上。

normal.en: trust as the key ingredient lifts the word to life.
normal.cn: 把信任当作关键要素，这个词就走向了人生。

abstract.en: One image: a row of bowls waiting by the stove.
abstract.cn: 只记一个画面：炉边一字排开的小碗。

abstract.en: Every great dish is a queue of stepping ingredients.
abstract.cn: 每道好菜都是一队依次入锅的配料。

abstract.en: Life recipes have invisible ingredients too.
abstract.cn: 人生的食谱里也有看不见的配料。

examples.en: List all the ingredients before you start cooking.
examples.cn: 开火前先列出所有原料。

examples.en: The cake needs five simple ingredients.
examples.cn: 这款蛋糕只需五种简单原料。

examples.en: Patience is an essential ingredient of learning.
examples.cn: 耐心是学习的必备要素。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「因格瑞迪恩特」：按「格」把料「递」进锅里， ingredient。

root: 拉丁语 in-「进入」+ gradi「迈步」→ ingredi「走入」→ 现在分词 ingrediens「正在进入之物」→ 中世纪拉丁语指成分 → 现代英语 ingredient；同根词 grade、gradual、progress。

sensesIntro.en: Ingredient is the bowl on the shelf: food stepping into the pot, powder inside the pill, and a quality stepping into success.
sensesIntro.cn: ingredient 是货架上的碗：走进锅里的食材、药丸里的粉末，以及走入成功的那种品质。

core.en: A thing that steps in and becomes part of the pot, pill or plan.
core.cn: 走入锅内、药丸或计划之中，成为其一部分的东西。

branches.en: KITCHEN: flour is the main ingredient.
MEDICINE: the active ingredient fights pain.
QUALITY: trust is the key ingredient.
MIXTURE: parts listed before mixing.
branches.cn: 混合：下锅前列明的部分。

branches.en: OUTCOME: qualities that produce results.

intro.en: Ingredient belongs to the gradi step family with grade, gradual and progress.
intro.cn: ingredient 属于 gradi 迈步词族，与 grade、gradual、progress 同根。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries show the stepping verb behind the family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁条目展示词族背后的迈步动词。

items.example: Ingress is on the east side.

definition_zh: 伤害；使受伤；损害（名誉等）
definition_en: to hurt a person or damage a part of the body, or to harm someone's good name
core_image: 绷带缠上小腿：身体某个部位被弄坏
scene: 球场上有人摔倒，队医快步跑来。He injured his knee during the match.
sceneCN: 这里 injure 是「使受伤」（第 1 个义项：弄伤身体部位）；句意：他在比赛中伤了膝盖。

derivatives.zh: injure 加名词后缀，义为「伤；损伤」
injure 加过去分词后缀，义为「受伤的」
injure 加形容词后缀，义为「有害的」

senses.title: To hurt the body
senses.definition: to harm a part of the body in an accident or attack
senses.definitionCN: 在事故或袭击中弄伤身体部位
senses.example: Two players were injured in the game.
senses.exampleCN: 两名球员在比赛中受伤。
senses.why: A bandage closes the broken part.
senses.whyCN: 绷带缠住坏掉的部位。

senses.title: To damage rights or interests
senses.definition: to harm someone's rights, interests or fortune
senses.definitionCN: 损害某人的权利、利益或财产
senses.example: The delay injured small businesses.
senses.exampleCN: 延误损害了小企业的利益。
senses.why: The bandage wraps a purse instead of an arm.
senses.whyCN: 绷带缠住的不是手臂而是钱袋。

senses.title: To hurt feelings or reputation
senses.definition: to wound pride, feelings or good name
senses.definitionCN: 伤害自尊、感情或好名声
senses.example: His words injured her deeply.
senses.why: The bandage is tied around a name.
senses.whyCN: 绷带缠在了名字上。

senses.title: To weaken a cause unfairly
senses.definition: to harm a case or cause by unfair treatment
senses.definitionCN: 以不公对待损害某个案件或事业
senses.example: Bad reporting injured the inquiry.
senses.exampleCN: 糟糕的报道损害了调查。
senses.why: The case limps like a hurt leg.
senses.whyCN: 案件像伤腿一样跛行。

intro.en: Injure comes from Latin injuriare, to act unjustly, from in- (not) plus jus, juris (law, right). To injure was first to wrong someone against what is right.
intro.cn: injure 来自拉丁语 injuriare「行不义」，由 in-「不」+ jus/juris「法律、正当」构成；injure 最初指对人行不义。

items.en: Latin jus, juris meant law and right; it gave justice, jury and judge.
items.cn: 拉丁语 jus/juris 意为法律与正当；同根词有 justice、jury、judge。

items.en: in- plus juris formed injuria: what is not right, an injustice.
items.cn: in- 加 juris 构成 injuria：不义之事。

items.en: injuriare meant to treat someone against right.
items.cn: injuriare 意为不义地对待某人。

items.en: Old French injurier carried both insult and bodily harm.
items.cn: 古法语 injurier 兼指辱骂与人身伤害。

items.en: Middle English injuren fixed the modern senses of bodily and moral harm.
items.cn: 中古英语 injuren 确立了身体与道义伤害两义。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the law-root family. The meaning group compares words of hurting.
note.cn: 形近组收录「法律」词根词族；词义组比较表示伤害的词。

entries.definition: to cause pain, body or heart.
entries.definitionCN: 造成疼痛，身体的或心里的。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the not-right root, the bandage image and the injury twin.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩利用「不义」词根、绷带意象与 injury 孪生词。

normal.en: in- plus jus (right): what is not right hurts.
normal.cn: in- 加 jus（正当）：不义即伤害。

normal.en: justice and jury share the same law root.
normal.cn: justice 与 jury 共享同一法律词根。

normal.en: injured his knee is the sports headline phrase.
normal.cn: injured his knee 是体育新闻常用说法。

normal.en: injury is the noun twin.
normal.cn: injury 是名词孪生词。

normal.en: injustice shows the root meaning best: unfairness.
normal.cn: injustice 最能体现词根本义：不公。

abstract.en: One image: a bandage that can wrap an arm, a purse or a name.
abstract.cn: 只记一个画面：绷带能缠手臂、钱袋，也能缠名字。

abstract.en: Injure is a wrong step against someone.
abstract.cn: injure 是对某人踏错的一步。

abstract.en: The scales tip and someone bleeds.
abstract.cn: 天平一斜，就有人流血。

examples.en: She injured her ankle on the stairs.
examples.cn: 她在楼梯上扭伤了脚踝。

examples.en: No one was injured in the fire.
examples.cn: 火灾中无人受伤。

examples.en: The false story injured his good name.
examples.cn: 虚假报道损害了他的名誉。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「因哲」：因为不义之举，让人「折」了筋骨， injure。

root: 拉丁语 in-「不」+ jus/juris「法律、正当」→ injuria「不义」→ injuriare「行不义」→ 古法语 injurier → 中古英语 injuren；本义「不义对待」，后扩展至身体伤害；同根词 justice、jury、judge。

sensesIntro.en: Injure is a bandage: it wraps a hurt leg, a hurt purse, a hurt name, and a limping cause.
sensesIntro.cn: injure 是一条绷带：缠住伤腿、受损的钱袋、受伤的名声，以及跛行的事业。

core.en: A wrong done against right, leaving the body, purse or name bandaged.
core.cn: 违逆正当而行的错，让身体、钱财或名声缠上绷带。

branches.en: WOUND: two players were injured.
LOSS: the delay injured small businesses.
branches.cn: 损失：延误损害了小企业。

branches.en: HUMILIATION: his words injured her.
DAMAGE: bad reporting injured the inquiry.
branches.cn: 损害：糟糕报道损害调查。

branches.en: WOUNDING: harm on body or heart.
branches.cn: 致伤：对身体或心灵的伤害。

intro.en: Injure builds injury, injured and injurious beside the law family.
intro.cn: injure 构成 injury、injured、injurious，并与法律词族相伴。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries show the right-law noun jus behind the family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁条目展示词族背后的正当法律名词 jus。

items.example: The injury kept him out for weeks.
The injured were taken to hospital.

latinEntries.meaning: law, right, that which is due

definition_en: a colored liquid used for writing, printing or drawing
core_image: 钢笔尖滴下的深色液体
scene: 书房里钢笔在纸上沙沙作响。The artist drew the cat in black ink.
sceneCN: 这里 ink 是「墨水」（第 1 个义项：书写用液体）；句意：画家用黑墨水画那只猫。

derivatives.zh: ink 加形容词后缀，义为「墨黑的；沾满墨水的」
ink 加 well 复合，义为「墨水池」
ink 加 pad 复合，义为「印台」

senses.title: Liquid for writing
senses.definition: colored liquid used for writing or drawing
senses.definitionCN: 用于书写或绘画的带色液体
senses.example: Sign the form in ink, not pencil.
senses.exampleCN: 请用墨水而非铅笔签名。
senses.why: The pen drinks black blood from the bottle.
senses.whyCN: 钢笔从瓶里喝下黑色的血。

senses.title: Printing fluid
senses.definition: liquid used by printing machines
senses.definitionCN: 印刷机使用的液体
senses.example: The news smelled of fresh ink.
senses.exampleCN: 报纸散发着新油墨的气味。
senses.why: The same liquid feeds the roller.
senses.whyCN: 同样的液体喂给滚筒。

senses.title: Money made, in accounting
senses.definition: black ink means profit in account books
senses.definitionCN: 账簿上黑墨代表盈利
senses.example: The store finally ran in black ink.
senses.why: The bookkeeper's pen decides the color of fate.
senses.whyCN: 账房先生的笔决定命运的颜色。

senses.title: To sign or fill with ink
senses.definition: to sign or mark something with ink
senses.definitionCN: 用墨水签署或标记
senses.example: Both teams inked the contract.
senses.why: The pen is dipped and pressed down on purpose.
senses.whyCN: 笔尖蘸墨，被刻意按下。

intro.en: Ink comes from Old French encre, from Late Latin encaustum, from Greek enkauston, something burned in. Purple ink was fixed with fire, like encaustic painting.
intro.cn: ink 来自古法语 encre，源自晚期拉丁语 encaustum，再溯源至希腊语 enkauston「以火烧定之物」。紫色墨水曾像蜡画一样用火固定。

items.en: Greek enkaiein meant to burn in; enkauston named fire-fixed paint.
items.cn: 希腊语 enkaiein 意为烧入；enkauston 指以火固定的颜料。

items.en: Late Latin encaustum named the imperial purple ink.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 encaustum 指帝国的紫色墨水。

items.en: Old French encre shortened the word as it traveled west.
items.cn: 古法语 encre 在西传途中缩短了词形。

items.en: Middle English enke or inke settled the spelling.
items.cn: 中古英语 enke/inke 确定了拼写。

items.en: Modern English added the verb sense and the business color code of red and black.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了动词义与账面上红黑两色的说法。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the ink family and its neighbors. The meaning group compares words of writing fluids.
note.cn: 形近组收录 ink 词族与相邻词；词义组比较书写用液的词。

entries.definition: the little bottle in old desks.
coloring liquid for cloth or hair.
entries.definitionCN: 给布或头发上色的液体。

entries.definition: the dry color powder before liquid.

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the burn origin, the in-ink rule and the red-black accounts.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩利用「火烧」词源、in ink 规则与红黑账目。

normal.en: Greek enkauston: ink was once fixed with fire.
normal.cn: 希腊语 enkauston：墨水曾用火固定。

normal.en: write in ink is the fixed pattern.
normal.cn: write in ink 是固定搭配。

normal.en: red ink is loss; black ink is profit.
normal.cn: red ink 是亏损，black ink 是盈利。

normal.en: inky describes fingers after a leaky pen.
normal.cn: inky 形容钢笔漏水后的手指。

normal.en: inked the contract is sports slang for signing.
normal.cn: inked the contract 是签约的体育俚语。

abstract.en: One image: a bottle of black blood for pens.
abstract.cn: 只记一个画面：一瓶给钢笔喝的黑血。

abstract.en: Ink is fire tamed into writing.
abstract.cn: ink 是被驯服进书写的火。

abstract.en: Every signature leaves a small dark wound on paper.
abstract.cn: 每个签名都在纸上留下小小的黑痕。

examples.en: Please fill in the form in blue ink.
examples.cn: 请用蓝墨水填表。

examples.en: An ink stain spread across the page.
examples.cn: 墨渍在纸上洇开。

examples.en: The company was finally in black ink.
examples.cn: 公司终于扭亏为盈。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「应刻」：墨水应刻在纸上留下痕迹， ink。

root: 希腊语 enkaiein「烧入」→ enkauston「火烧固定的颜料」→ 晚期拉丁语 encaustum「紫色墨水」→ 古法语 encre → 中古英语 enke/inke → 现代英语 ink。

sensesIntro.en: Ink is bottled dark blood: for the pen, the press, the account book, and the contract waiting to be signed.
sensesIntro.cn: ink 是瓶装的黑血：喂钢笔、喂印刷机、写进账本，以及按在待签的合同上。

core.en: Dark liquid that carries words, pictures and even profit.
core.cn: 承载文字、图画乃至盈亏的深色液体。

branches.en: WRITING: sign the form in ink.
PRESS: news smelled of fresh ink.
PROFIT: finally ran in black ink.
SIGNATURE: both teams inked the contract.
DARKNESS: black ink on white paper.

intro.en: Ink builds inky, inkwell, inkpad and the phrases in ink and red ink.
intro.cn: ink 构成 inky、inkwell、inkpad 及短语 in ink、red ink。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries show the Greek burning root behind the ink.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁条目展示墨水背后的希腊火烧词根。

items.example: The pen ran out of ink.
The old desk has an inkwell.
Press the stamp on the inkpad.

latinEntries.meaningCN: 紫色墨水；火烧固定的颜料

definition_en: a small animal with six legs and a body in three parts, such as a bee or ant
core_image: 切成三节、六条腿的小身体
scene: 夏天的花园里蜜蜂嗡嗡绕花。An insect landed on the window and crawled away.
sceneCN: 这里 insect 是「昆虫」（第 1 个义项：六足小动物）；句意：一只昆虫落在窗上又爬走了。

derivatives.zh: insect 加杀灭后缀 -cide，义为「杀虫剂」
insect 加食性后缀，义为「食虫的」
昆虫学，研究 insect 的学科

senses.title: Six-legged small animal
senses.definition: a small animal with six legs and a three-part body
senses.definitionCN: 六足、身体分三节的小动物
senses.example: Bees and ants are insects.
senses.why: The body is cut into three notches.
senses.whyCN: 身体像被刻成三节。

senses.title: Any small crawling creature
senses.definition: loosely, any small bug-like creature
senses.definitionCN: 泛指小虫子
senses.example: Insects gathered round the lamp.
senses.why: Every notch-legged crawler joins the crowd.
senses.whyCN: 凡带小节的爬行者都入了群。

senses.title: A contemptible person
senses.definition: a person treated as worthless, a figurative use
senses.definitionCN: 被当作微不足道的人，比喻用法
senses.example: He crushed his rivals like insects.
senses.exampleCN: 他把对手当虫子般踩扁。
senses.why: The six legs are stamped underfoot.
senses.whyCN: 六条腿被踩在脚下。

intro.en: Insect comes from Latin insectum, a cut-up thing, from in- (into) and secare (to cut). The name describes the notched waist that divides the body.
intro.cn: insect 来自拉丁语 insectum「被切分之物」，由 in-「切入」+ secare「切割」构成；名称刻画昆虫分节的腰身。

items.en: Latin secare meant to cut; it gave section, sector and scissors.
items.cn: 拉丁语 secare 意为切割；同根词有 section、sector、scissors。

items.en: in- plus secare formed insecare: to cut into, notched.
items.cn: in- 加 secare 构成 insecare：切入而留缺口。

items.en: Pliny used insectum as the calque of Greek entomon, the notched animal.
items.cn: 普林尼用 insectum 对译希腊语 entomon「有缺刻的动物」。

items.en: Greek entomon itself meant cut into segments.
items.cn: 希腊语 entomon 本义即「切成数节」。

items.en: English took insect from Latin in the scientific revival.
items.cn: 科学复兴时期英语从拉丁语借入 insect。

items.en: Modern English generalized it to all small bugs and added the figurative insult.
items.cn: 现代英语将其泛化为一切小虫，并添了轻蔑比喻。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the cut-root family. The meaning group compares small creatures.
note.cn: 形近组收录「切割」词根词族；词义组比较小动物词。

entries.definition: eight legs, not a true insect.

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the cut body image, the section family and the six-leg rule.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩利用切分身躯的画面、section 词族与六足规则。

normal.en: in- plus secare (cut): a body cut into three parts.
normal.cn: in- 加 secare（切）：身体被切成三节。

normal.en: Six legs, three parts: that is a true insect.
normal.cn: 六足三节：这才是真正的昆虫。

normal.en: section, sector and insect share one cutting root.
normal.cn: section、sector 与 insect 共享切割词根。

normal.en: Spiders have eight legs, so they are not insects.
normal.cn: 蜘蛛八足，所以不是昆虫。

normal.en: insecticide is the killer word for pests.
normal.cn: insecticide 是杀虫的利器词。

abstract.en: One image: a body notched into three little drums.
abstract.cn: 只记一个画面：身体被刻成三只小鼓。

abstract.en: An insect is a walking cut-out.
abstract.cn: 昆虫是行走的剪纸。

abstract.en: Scissors and insects: both born from one cut.
abstract.cn: 剪刀与昆虫：同出一剪。

examples.en: Use insect repellent in the forest.
examples.cn: 在森林里要涂驱虫剂。

examples.en: Many insects pollinate flowers.
examples.cn: 许多昆虫为花授粉。

examples.en: An insect bite swelled up overnight.
examples.cn: 虫咬处一夜之间肿了起来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「因塞克特」：昆虫的身体因切分而特（别）分明， insect。

root: 拉丁语 in-「切入」+ secare「切割」→ insectum「有缺刻之物」（对译希腊语 entomon）→ 科学拉丁语 → 现代英语 insect；同根词 section、sector、scissors、dissect。

sensesIntro.en: Insect is the notched body: the true six-legged animal, any small bug, and the person stamped underfoot.
sensesIntro.cn: insect 是有缺刻的身体：真正的六足小兽、泛指的小虫，以及被踩在脚下的人。

core.en: A small body cut into three parts, walking on six legs.
core.cn: 被切成三节、靠六足行走的小身体。

branches.en: ANATOMY: bees and ants are insects.
CROWD: insects gathered round the lamp.
CONTEMPT: rivals crushed like insects.
CRAWLING: notch-legged walkers.
SWARM: bugs around the summer light.

intro.en: Insect builds insecticide, insectivorous and joins the secare cutting family.
intro.cn: insect 构成 insecticide、insectivorous，并属 secare 切割词族。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries show the cutting verb secare behind the family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁条目展示词族背后的切割动词 secare。

items.meaning: a cut slice of the economy

latinEntries.meaningCN: 有缺刻、切成数节的动物

definition_en: the inner part or surface of something; located within
core_image: 盒盖合上后灯还亮着的那一小块空间
scene: 快递箱拆开时全家都围了上来。The keys are inside the drawer.
sceneCN: 这里 inside 是「在里面」（第 1 个义项：处于内部）；句意：钥匙在抽屉里面。

derivatives.zh: inside 加施动者后缀，义为「内部人士」
inside 的复数，义为「内脏；内部构造」
反义词，义为「外部」

senses.title: The inner part of a thing
senses.definition: the inner part or surface of something
senses.definitionCN: 物体的内部或内表面
senses.example: The inside of the bag is lined with silk.
senses.why: Open the lid and the lamp space appears.
senses.whyCN: 掀开盖子，那片亮着的小空间出现。

senses.title: Within a place or thing
senses.definition: located or moving within something
senses.definitionCN: 位于或进入某物之内
senses.example: The cat hid inside the wardrobe.
senses.why: The lid closes and the space holds its guest.
senses.whyCN: 盖子合上，小空间收留了客人。

senses.title: Inner-facing position
senses.definition: facing or belonging to the inner side
senses.definitionCN: 朝向或属于内侧
senses.example: Keep the map in your inside pocket.
senses.why: The pocket sewn toward the lamp space.
senses.whyCN: 缝向那片小空间的口袋。

senses.title: Secret, known to a few
senses.definition: known only to people within a group
senses.definitionCN: 只有圈内人知晓
senses.example: He traded on inside information.
senses.why: Only those under the lid can see the lamp.
senses.whyCN: 只有盖子下的人看得见灯。

senses.title: Into the interior
senses.definition: moving toward the inner part
senses.definitionCN: 向内部移动
senses.example: They went inside when it snowed.
senses.exampleCN: 下雪时他们走进了屋里。
senses.why: One step across the lid line.
senses.whyCN: 跨过盖线的一步。

intro.en: Inside is in + side, formed inside English. The picture is simply the side that faces inward.
intro.cn: inside 由 in + side 在英语内部合成，画面就是朝向内侧的那一面。

items.en: Old English side meant the flank or edge of a body.
items.cn: 古英语 side 指身体的侧边或边缘。

items.en: Phrases like inside of a house named the inner flank.
items.cn: 短语 inside of a house 指屋子的内侧。

items.en: The compound fused into one word for all positions.
items.cn: 复合词融为一体，用于各种位置。

items.en: Modern English spread it to time (inside a week) and secrets.
items.cn: 现代英语将其扩展到时间（一周之内）与内幕。

items.en: Insider was coined for the person who stands under the lid.
items.cn: insider 一词被造出来，指站在盖子下的人。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the side family. The meaning group compares words of being within.
note.cn: 形近组收录 side 词族；词义组比较表示「在内」的词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the inner side image, the pocket pair and the secret use.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩利用内侧面意象、内袋配对与内幕用法。

normal.en: in plus side: the side that faces inward.
normal.cn: in 加 side：朝内的一面。

normal.en: an inside pocket faces your body.
normal.cn: an inside pocket 贴着身体。

normal.en: inside information is for under-the-lid ears.
normal.cn: inside information 是盖子下的耳语。

normal.en: insides means your inner parts.
normal.cn: insides 指体内器官。

normal.en: outside is the mirror twin.
normal.cn: outside 是镜子里的孪生词。

abstract.en: One image: a lit space after the lid clicks shut.
abstract.cn: 只记一个画面：盖子咔哒合上后仍亮着的小空间。

abstract.en: Inside is where the lamp keeps burning unseen.
abstract.cn: inside 是灯在无人处仍亮着的地方。

abstract.en: Every box keeps a warm heart.
abstract.cn: 每个盒子都藏着一颗温暖的心。

examples.en: There is a label inside the jacket.
examples.cn: 夹克内侧有一张标签。

examples.en: She knows the industry from the inside.
examples.cn: 她从内部了解这个行业。

examples.en: The parcel was damaged on the inside.
examples.cn: 包裹内部受损了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「因塞德」：因藏于内，塞得深德（得）稳， inside。

root: 古英语 side「侧边」→ 中古英语短语 inside of「……的内侧」→ 复合为介词、名词、形容词、副词 inside → 现代英语扩展出内幕义；反义 outside。

sensesIntro.en: Inside is the inward side: the lit space under a lid, the pocket turned to the body, the secret kept under it, and the step across the line.
sensesIntro.cn: inside 是朝内的一面：盖下亮着的空间、贴身的口袋、盖下保守的秘密，以及跨线的那一步。

core.en: The side that faces inward and keeps what the lid closes in.
core.cn: 朝向内侧、在盖合之后收藏一切的那一面。

branches.en: INTERIOR: lined with silk inside.
ENCLOSURE: hid inside the wardrobe.
PROXIMITY: the inside pocket.
SECRECY: inside information.
ENTRY: they went inside.

intro.en: Inside builds insider, insides and its mirror outside.
intro.cn: inside 构成 insider、insides 及镜面词 outside。

latinIntro.en: No Latin entries: this compound is pure English.
latinIntro.cn: 无拉丁条目：该复合词是纯正英语造词。

items.example: The insides of the clock were clean.
A lamp stood beside the bed.

definition_en: to demand something firmly or keep saying that something is true
core_image: 双手撑地不肯挪动的双脚
scene: 孩子攥着书包带不肯松手。She insisted on paying the bill herself.
sceneCN: 这里 insist 是「坚决要求」（第 2 个义项：坚定地索要）；句意：她坚持自己付账。

derivatives.zh: insist 加名词后缀，义为「坚持；执意」
insist 加形容词后缀，义为「急切的；坚持的」
换前缀的同根词，义为「持续；坚持不放弃」

senses.title: To demand firmly
senses.definition: to ask for something strongly and refuse to give up
senses.definitionCN: 强烈要求且不肯让步
senses.example: He insisted on an apology.
senses.why: Both feet are planted and will not move.
senses.whyCN: 双脚扎根，寸步不让。

senses.title: To keep standing on
senses.definition: to keep taking a stand without yielding
senses.definitionCN: 坚守立场而不退让
senses.example: She insisted on her innocence.
senses.why: The feet stay planted on one spot.
senses.whyCN: 双脚立定原地。

senses.title: To declare against doubt
senses.definition: to state something firmly while others disagree
senses.definitionCN: 在他人存疑时坚定地陈述
senses.example: He insisted that the door was locked.
senses.why: The voice repeats while hands point at the spot.
senses.whyCN: 手指出原地，声音反复重申。

senses.title: If you insist: polite yielding
senses.definition: a polite phrase meaning I agree because you demand it
senses.definitionCN: 表示因对方坚持而同意的客套话
senses.example: If you insist, I will take the window seat.
senses.exampleCN: 你坚持的话，我就坐靠窗吧。
senses.why: The feet step aside because the other's feet will not.
senses.whyCN: 对方的脚不移，自己的脚只好让开。

intro.en: Insist comes from Latin insistere, to stand upon, from in- (upon) and stare (to stand). To insist is literally to keep standing on your demand.
intro.cn: insist 来自拉丁语 insistere「站立其上」，由 in-「其上」+ stare「站立」构成；insist 字面就是一直站在你的要求上。

items.en: Latin stare meant to stand; it gave stay, statue and steady.
items.cn: 拉丁语 stare 意为站立；同根词有 stay、statue、steady。

items.en: in- plus stare formed insistere: to stand upon, to dwell on.
items.cn: in- 加 stare 构成 insistere：立于其上、执着于。

items.en: Insistere could mean to pause on or to persist in pressing.
items.cn: insistere 可指停留，也可指持续施压。

items.en: Old French insister passed the sense of pressing a demand.
items.cn: 古法语 insister 传递「施压索求」之义。

items.en: Middle English insisten meant to pursue or dwell upon.
items.cn: 中古英语 insisten 意为追索、执着于。

items.en: Modern English settled the demand and declare senses.
items.cn: 现代英语定型了索求与坚称两义。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the stand-root family. The meaning group compares words of holding firm.
note.cn: 形近组收录「站立」词根词族；词义组比较表示坚守的词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the standing root, the insist-on pattern and the polite phrase.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩利用「站立」词根、insist on 句式与客套用语。

normal.en: in- plus stare (stand): keep standing on your point.
normal.cn: in- 加 stare（站立）：一直站在你的立场上。

normal.en: insist on plus noun is the exam pattern.
normal.cn: insist on 加名词是考试句式。

normal.en: persist is the patient twin; resist the fighting twin.
normal.cn: persist 是耐心的孪生词，resist 是对抗的孪生词。

normal.en: if you insist softens the firmness politely.
normal.cn: if you insist 客气地软化坚持。

normal.en: statue and stay share the standing root.
normal.cn: statue 与 stay 共享站立词根。

abstract.en: One image: shoes rooted to the floor while the room argues.
abstract.cn: 只记一个画面：满屋争论，鞋跟却长进地板。

abstract.en: To insist is to be a statue with a voice.
abstract.cn: insist 就是有声音的雕像。

abstract.en: The clock ticks; the feet stay.
abstract.cn: 钟在走，脚不动。

examples.en: He insisted that the report be rewritten.
examples.cn: 他坚持要求重写报告。

examples.en: I insisted on seeing the manager.
examples.cn: 我坚持要见经理。

examples.en: If you insist, we can leave tonight.
examples.cn: 你坚持的话，我们今晚就走。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「因西斯特」：西边的铁塔一直「立」着不倒， insist。

root: 拉丁语 in-「其上」+ stare「站立」→ insistere「立于其上、执着于」→ 古法语 insister → 中古英语 insisten → 现代英语 insist；同根词 persist、resist、stay、statue。

sensesIntro.en: Insist is planted feet: a demand that will not move, a stand held under doubt, a voice that repeats, and a polite step aside.
sensesIntro.cn: insist 是扎了根的脚：不让步的要求、存疑下的坚守、反复重申的声音，以及客气的让步。

core.en: Standing on your own point until the world moves or you do.
core.cn: 站在自己的立场上，直到世界让步或你让步。

branches.en: DEMAND: insisted on an apology.
STAND: insisted on her innocence.
ASSERTION: insisted that the door was locked.
YIELDING: if you insist, the window seat.
PRESSURE: feet planted, voice repeated.

intro.en: Insist builds insistence, insistent and its standing twins persist and resist.
intro.cn: insist 构成 insistence、insistent 及孪生词 persist、resist。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries show the standing verb stare behind the family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁条目展示词族背后的站立动词 stare。

definition_en: a single example or case of something happening
core_image: 从一大群里拎出来给你看的那一只
scene: 老师翻开课本举了个例句。In this instance, patience worked better than speed.
sceneCN: 这里 instance 是「例子」（第 2 个义项：具体事例）；句意：在这个例子中，耐心比速度更有效。

derivatives.zh: 同根近形词，义为「立即的；即食的」
instant 加副词后缀，义为「立刻」
instant 加复合后缀，义为「瞬间的」

senses.title: A single case of a thing
senses.definition: one particular occurrence of a general thing
senses.definitionCN: 一般事物的某次具体出现
senses.example: This is an instance of pure luck.
senses.why: One bird is lifted from the flock to be shown.
senses.whyCN: 从鸟群里拎出一只给你看。

senses.title: An example given to explain
senses.definition: an example offered to make a point clear
senses.definitionCN: 为说明观点而举的例子
senses.example: Take Japan, for instance.
senses.why: The lifted bird is held up as a lesson.
senses.whyCN: 拎出的那只鸟被举作教材。

senses.title: A situation or occasion
senses.definition: a particular situation requiring action
senses.definitionCN: 需要应对的特定情况
senses.example: In most instances, a warning is enough.
senses.exampleCN: 在多数情况下，警告就够了。
senses.why: The flock walks on; only the lifted bird needs a name.
senses.whyCN: 群鸟自行走，只有被拎出的那只需要命名。

senses.title: At the instance of: by request
senses.definition: because of someone's formal request
senses.definitionCN: 应某人的正式请求
senses.example: The park was named at the instance of the mayor.
senses.why: The bird is lifted because a hand asks.
senses.whyCN: 那只鸟被拎出，是因为有一只手发了话。

intro.en: Instance comes from Latin instantia, a standing near or pressing presence, from instare (to stand upon). An instance is a case that stands close enough to be shown.
intro.cn: instance 来自拉丁语 instantia「近身站立、紧逼的存在」，出自 instare「立于其上」；instance 是站得够近、可以被指给你看的案例。

items.en: Latin stare meant to stand, the same root family as insist.
items.cn: 拉丁语 stare 意为站立，与 insist 同族。

items.en: in- plus stare formed instare: to stand upon, press near.
items.cn: in- 加 stare 构成 instare：立于其上、贴近逼近。

items.en: instantia meant pressing urgency, then a present case.
items.cn: instantia 先指紧逼的紧迫，后指眼前案例。

items.en: Old French instance carried both urgency and example.
items.cn: 古法语 instance 兼指紧迫与例子。

items.en: Middle English instance settled on the example sense.
items.cn: 中古英语 instance 落定于例子义。

items.en: for instance became the classic way to lift one case out.
items.cn: for instance 成为拎出个案的经典说法。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the standing family with its instant twins. The meaning group compares example words.
note.cn: 形近组收录站立词族与 instant 孪生词；词义组比较例子类词汇。

entries.definition: a piece taken to represent the whole.

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the standing-near root, the for-instance pattern and the instant twin.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩利用「近身站立」词根、for instance 句式与 instant 孪生词。

normal.en: in- plus stare: a case that stands near enough to show.
normal.cn: in- 加 stare：站得够近、能指给人看的案例。

normal.en: for instance is the classic exam phrase.
normal.cn: for instance 是经典考试用语。

normal.en: instant and instance are one family: nearness in time and in view.
normal.cn: instant 与 instance 同族：时间与视线上的贴近。

normal.en: in many instances means in most situations.
normal.cn: in many instances 意为多数情况下。

normal.en: distance looks alike but means space apart.
normal.cn: distance 形似而意为相隔。

abstract.en: One image: one bird lifted from a flock for show.
abstract.cn: 只记一个画面：从鸟群拎出一只展示。

abstract.en: An instance is the whole story squeezed into one case.
abstract.cn: instance 是把整个故事压进一个案例。

abstract.en: Point at one, and the crowd becomes clear.
abstract.cn: 指着一只，群像便清晰。

examples.en: For instance, ants farm aphids for honeydew.
examples.cn: 例如，蚂蚁会放牧蚜虫取蜜。

examples.en: This is a rare instance of honest advertising.
examples.cn: 这是诚实广告的罕见实例。

examples.en: In most instances, early trains are emptier.
examples.cn: 多数情况下，早班列车更空。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「因斯坦斯」：像爱因斯坦那样举一个经典实例， instance。

root: 拉丁语 in-「贴近」+ stare「站立」→ instare「立于其前」→ instantia「眼前的案例、紧迫」→ 古法语 instance → 中古英语 instance；与 instant、insist 同根。

sensesIntro.en: Instance is the lifted bird: one case shown for the flock, the situation that needs a name, and the hand that asks for it.
sensesIntro.cn: instance 是被拎出的鸟：为群像而展示的个案、需要命名的情况，以及那只发话的手。

core.en: A case standing close enough to be lifted out and shown.
core.cn: 站得够近、可以被拎出来展示的案例。

branches.en: OCCURRENCE: an instance of pure luck.
ILLUSTRATION: take Japan, for instance.
SITUATION: in most instances, a warning suffices.
branches.cn: 情况：多数情况下警告即可。

branches.en: REQUEST: named at the instance of the mayor.
SHOWING: one case held up for all.
branches.cn: 展示：为整体举起一个案例。

intro.en: Instance keeps company with instant, instantly and the standing family.
intro.cn: instance 与 instant、instantly 及站立词族相伴。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries show the standing verb behind the family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁条目展示词族背后的站立动词。

definition_en: in the place of something else; as a replacement or an unexpected opposite
core_image: 两扇门之间你推开了旁边那一扇
scene: 本想看电影，结果去了公园。It rained, so we watched a film at home instead.
sceneCN: 这里 instead 是「反而」（第 2 个义项：出现相反结果）；句意：下雨了，我们只好在家看电影。

derivatives.zh: 古旧名词，义为「位置；用处」（in one's stead）
instead 加介词构成的短语介词，义为「而不是」

senses.title: In place of something
senses.definition: in the place of someone or something else
senses.definitionCN: 处在别的人或事物的位置上
senses.example: There was no tea, so we drank coffee instead.
senses.why: The next door opens when one is locked.
senses.whyCN: 一扇门锁上，旁边那扇便被推开。

senses.title: An unexpected opposite result
senses.definition: introducing what happened instead of what was expected
senses.definitionCN: 引出与预期相反的结果
senses.example: He did not help; instead, he laughed.
senses.why: The wrong door swings open with a grin.
senses.whyCN: 被推开的竟是那扇带着讥笑的门。

senses.title: Instead of: phrase use
senses.definition: used before a noun or verb-ing to replace it
senses.definitionCN: 后接名词或动名词，表示替换
senses.example: Walk instead of taking the bus.
senses.why: Two doors hang side by side; you choose one.
senses.whyCN: 两扇门并排，只推其一。

intro.en: Instead is in + stead, from Old English stede, a place. To take something in stead is to take it in its place.
intro.cn: instead 由 in + stead 构成，stead 出自古英语 stede「地方」；in stead 即「处其位」。

items.en: Old English stede meant a place or spot; place names still keep it.
items.cn: 古英语 stede 意为地方；地名中仍有留存。

items.en: The phrase in stedes meant in the place of.
items.cn: 短语 in stedes 意为居于其位。

items.en: Middle English in stead solidified into one written word.
items.cn: 中古英语 in stead 固化为一个词。

items.en: instead of grew into the standard replacement phrase.
items.cn: instead of 发展成标准的替换短语。

items.en: The old noun survives only in the legal in one's stead.
items.cn: 古名词只存活在法律用语 in one's stead 中。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the stead family. The meaning group compares words of replacement and contrast.
note.cn: 形近组收录 stead 词族；词义组比较替换与转折类词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the place root, the two-doors image and the instead-of rule.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩利用「地方」词根、双门意象与 instead of 规则。

normal.en: in plus stead (place): taken into another's place.
normal.cn: in 加 stead（位置）：顶了别人的位。

normal.en: stead survives in legal in one's stead.
normal.cn: stead 只在法律用语 in one's stead 里存活。

normal.en: instead of plus noun or verb-ing.
normal.cn: instead of 后接名词或动名词。

normal.en: steady shares the place root: steady in its place.
normal.cn: steady 同根：稳在其位。

normal.en: He laughed instead: the unexpected door.
normal.cn: 他反而大笑：推开了那扇意外的门。

abstract.en: One image: two doors, one hand, the second chosen.
abstract.cn: 只记一个画面：两扇门，一次选择，推开了第二扇。

abstract.en: Instead is the plan B hiding beside plan A.
abstract.cn: instead 是躲在计划 A 旁边的计划 B。

abstract.en: Where one chair is empty, another slides in.
abstract.cn: 一把椅子空了，另一把滑过来。

examples.en: Use honey instead of sugar.
examples.cn: 用蜂蜜代替糖。

examples.en: She did not cry; instead, she smiled.
examples.cn: 她没哭，反而笑了。

examples.en: If Tuesday is full, come Wednesday instead.
examples.cn: 周二满了就改周三来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「因斯特德」：因原计划黄了，换了斯特德来顶替， instead。

root: 古英语 stede「地方」→ 短语 in stedes「处其位」→ 中古英语 in stead → 现代英语 instead；同根词 stead、steady、steadfast。

sensesIntro.en: Instead is the second door: a seat taken in another's place, the grin of an opposite result, and the phrase that picks between two doors.
sensesIntro.cn: instead 是第二扇门：顶替他人的位置、相反结果的讥笑，以及在两扇门之间替你作选择的短语。

core.en: A hand that pushes the neighboring door when the first is shut.
core.cn: 第一扇门关上时，推开了旁边那扇门的手。

branches.en: SUBSTITUTION: drank coffee instead.
CONTRAST: instead, he laughed.
CHOICE: walk instead of taking the bus.
PREFERENCE: picking the second door.
SURPRISE: what happened was the opposite.

intro.en: Instead keeps the old stead alive and pairs with instead of.
intro.cn: instead 保留了古词 stead，并与 instead of 搭配。

latinIntro.en: No Latin entries: this compound is pure English.
latinIntro.cn: 无拉丁条目：该复合词是纯正英语造词。

items.example: He came in his father's stead.

definition_en: a direction telling you what to do, or the act of teaching someone
core_image: 说明书上印着一步一步的箭头
scene: 桌面上摊着新家具的装配图。Follow the instructions before you plug it in.
sceneCN: 这里 instruction 是「指示」（第 1 个义项：告诉你做什么的说明）；句意：插电前请先看说明书。

derivatives.zh: instruction 的动词基，义为「指示；教导」
instruct 加施动者后缀，义为「教员；指导员」
instruction 加形容词后缀，义为「教学的」

senses.title: A direction to act
senses.definition: an order or direction telling someone what to do
senses.definitionCN: 告诉某人做什么的命令或指示
senses.example: We waited for instructions from the office.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在等办公室的指示。
senses.why: An arrow on the page points at your hands.
senses.whyCN: 纸上的箭头指向你的双手。

senses.title: Steps for using something
senses.definition: written steps explaining how to use or make something
senses.definitionCN: 说明如何使用或制作的成文步骤
senses.example: Read the assembly instructions first.
senses.why: The arrows form a small staircase of steps.
senses.whyCN: 箭头连成小小的阶梯。

senses.title: The act of teaching
senses.definition: the act or process of teaching knowledge or skills
senses.definitionCN: 传授知识或技能的行为
senses.example: Instruction in the pool begins Monday.
senses.why: The arrow bends into a teacher's finger.
senses.whyCN: 箭头弯成了老师的手指。

senses.title: Computer commands
senses.definition: a single command a computer can perform
senses.definitionCN: 计算机可执行的一条命令
senses.example: The chip runs millions of instructions per second.
senses.exampleCN: 芯片每秒执行数百万条指令。
senses.why: The arrow is etched into silicon.
senses.whyCN: 箭头被刻进了硅片。

intro.en: Instruction comes from Latin instruere, to build into or pile up for teaching, from in- (in) and struere (to build). Teaching was seen as building knowledge into a person.
intro.cn: instruction 来自拉丁语 instruere「砌入、堆叠以教导」，由 in-「在内」+ struere「建造」构成；教学被视为把知识砌进人心里。

items.en: Latin struere meant to build up, the same root as structure.
items.cn: 拉丁语 struere 意为垒建，与 structure 同根。

items.en: in- plus struere formed instruere: to build in, to educate.
items.cn: in- 加 struere 构成 instruere：砌入，引申为教育。

items.en: Latin instructio named the act of equipping with knowledge.
items.cn: 拉丁语 instructio 指以知识装备人的行为。

items.en: Old French instruction passed the word to English.
items.cn: 古法语 instruction 把词传给英语。

items.en: Middle English instruccioun covered teaching and orders alike.
items.cn: 中古英语 instruccioun 兼指教学与命令。

items.en: Modern English added the printed manual and the computer command.
items.cn: 现代英语新增了印刷说明与计算机指令两义。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the build-root family. The meaning group compares words of orders and teaching.
note.cn: 形近组收录「建造」词根词族；词义组比较命令与教学类词。

entries.definitionCN: 说明书常用的复数形式。
建造出的工具，同出 struere。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the build root, the arrow diagram and the manual phrase.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩利用「建造」词根、箭头图示与手册短语。

normal.en: in- plus struere (build): knowledge built into you.
normal.cn: in- 加 struere（建造）：把知识砌进你心里。

normal.en: follow the instructions is the classic exam phrase.
normal.cn: follow the instructions 是经典考试用语。

normal.en: instruction manual goes with every gadget.
normal.cn: 每件电器都配 instruction manual。

normal.en: instrument is its tool cousin.
normal.cn: instrument 是它的工具表亲。

normal.en: a CPU runs instructions: arrows etched in silicon.
normal.cn: CPU 执行 instructions：硅片刻箭头。

abstract.en: One image: a staircase of printed arrows leading your hands.
abstract.cn: 只记一个画面：印成一列的箭头像小阶梯引着你的手。

abstract.en: Every manual is a building plan for your hands.
abstract.cn: 每份说明书都是给双手的施工图。

abstract.en: Orders are arrows; teaching bends them gently.
abstract.cn: 命令是直箭头，教学把箭头轻轻弯成手指。

examples.en: The kit comes with illustrated instructions.
examples.cn: 套装附带图示说明书。

examples.en: Pilots received new instructions before takeoff.
examples.cn: 飞行员起飞前接到了新指示。

examples.en: Swimming instruction is free for beginners.
examples.cn: 初学者的游泳教学免费。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「因斯特拉坤申」：按步骤一条条拉出说明， instruction。

root: 拉丁语 in-「在内」+ struere「建造」→ instruere「砌入、教导」→ instructio → 古法语 instruction → 中古英语 instruccioun → 现代英语 instruction；同根词 structure、instrument、construct。

sensesIntro.en: Instruction is the printed arrow: an order pointing at you, a staircase of steps, a teacher's bent finger, and a command etched in silicon.
sensesIntro.cn: instruction 是印出来的箭头：指向你的命令、成阶梯的步骤、弯成手指的教学，以及刻进硅片的指令。

core.en: Knowledge built into a person like stones into a wall, one arrow at a time.
core.cn: 知识像砌墙般一块块砌进人心里，每次一枚箭头。

branches.en: ORDER: waited for instructions from the office.
MANUAL: read the assembly instructions.
