TEACHING: instruction in the pool begins Monday.
branches.cn: 教学：泳池教学周一开始。

branches.en: COMMAND: millions of instructions per second.
DIRECTION: arrows pointing at your hands.
branches.cn: 指引：箭头指向你的双手。

intro.en: Instruction builds instruct, instructor and instructional, beside the struere family.
intro.cn: instruction 构成 instruct、instructor、instructional，并与 struere 词族相伴。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries show the building verb struere behind the family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁条目展示词族背后的建造动词 struere。

items.example: A flute is a musical instrument.

definition_en: a tool made for a task, a device for making music, or a means to an end
core_image: 墙上一排挂着的工具与乐器
scene: 琴房里小提琴斜靠在琴架上。She plays three musical instruments.
sceneCN: 这里 instrument 是「乐器」（第 2 个义项：发声器具）；句意：她会演奏三种乐器。

derivatives.zh: instrument 加形容词后缀，义为「起作用的；器乐的」
instrument 加名词后缀，义为「乐器编配；仪表设备」
instrument 加施动者后缀，义为「器乐演奏者」

senses.title: A tool for a precise task
senses.definition: a device made to carry out careful work
senses.definitionCN: 为精细工作而造的装置
senses.example: The lab has delicate instruments.
senses.why: A polished tool hangs ready on the wall.
senses.whyCN: 磨亮的工具挂在墙上待命。

senses.title: A device that makes music
senses.definition: a device for playing music
senses.definitionCN: 用来演奏音乐的装置
senses.example: The violin is a string instrument.
senses.why: The tool is tuned until it sings.
senses.whyCN: 工具被调音，直至歌唱。

senses.title: A means to an end
senses.definition: a person or thing used to achieve a result
senses.definitionCN: 用以达成结果的手段
senses.example: Trade was an instrument of empire.
senses.why: The hung tool is taken down for larger plans.
senses.whyCN: 墙上的工具被取下用于更大的图谋。

senses.title: A formal legal document
senses.definition: a written legal paper, formal use
senses.definitionCN: 书面的法律文件，正式用法
senses.example: Both parties signed the instrument.
senses.why: The tool turns into paper with a seal.
senses.whyCN: 工具化身为盖了章的纸。

intro.en: Instrument comes from Latin instrumentum, equipment, built on instruere, to build in or prepare. A tool is knowledge built into a handle.
intro.cn: instrument 来自拉丁语 instrumentum「装备」，建立在 instruere「砌入、备置」之上；工具就是把知识砌进握柄。

items.en: Latin struere meant to build, the root behind structure.
items.cn: 拉丁语 struere 意为建造，是 structure 的词根。

items.en: instruere meant to build in, arrange, prepare.
items.cn: instruere 意为砌入、布置、备妥。

items.en: instrumentum named equipment and implement.
items.cn: instrumentum 指装备与器具。

items.en: Old French instrument carried both tool and written record.
items.cn: 古法语 instrument 兼指工具与文书。

items.en: Middle English instrument added the music sense in court and church.
items.cn: 中古英语 instrument 在宫廷与教会里添了乐义。

items.en: Modern English split the senses into tool, music, means and document.
items.cn: 现代英语把词义分为工具、乐器、手段与文书。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the build-root family. The meaning group compares words of tools.
note.cn: 形近组收录「建造」词根词族；词义组比较工具类词。

entries.definition: helpful in achieving something; of music without words.
a made object for a purpose.

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the build root, the wall of tools and the music twist.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩利用「建造」词根、挂满工具的墙与音乐转折。

normal.en: instruere: built-in knowledge in a handle.
normal.cn: instruere：把知识砌进握柄。

normal.en: structure, construct and instrument share one root.
normal.cn: structure、construct 与 instrument 同根。

normal.en: musical instrument is the school phrase.
normal.cn: musical instrument 是校园常用语。

normal.en: instrumental means both helpful and without vocals.
normal.cn: instrumental 兼指起作用与纯器乐。

normal.en: a signed instrument is legal paper.
normal.cn: 签署的 instrument 是法律文书。

abstract.en: One image: a wall where hammers and violins hang together.
abstract.cn: 只记一个画面：锤子与小提琴同挂一面墙。

abstract.en: Every instrument is a built idea you can hold.
abstract.cn: 每件 instrument 都是可以握住的建造好的想法。

abstract.en: Tune the tool until it sings.
abstract.cn: 把工具调到会唱歌。

examples.en: The surgeon checked each instrument twice.
examples.cn: 外科医生把每件器械检查了两遍。

examples.en: Learning an instrument takes patience.
examples.cn: 学乐器需要耐心。

examples.en: Diplomacy was their chief instrument of change.
examples.cn: 外交是他们变革的主要手段。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「因斯特拉门特」：门特（别）灵的器械全挂墙上， instrument。

root: 拉丁语 in-「砌入」+ struere「建造」→ instruere「备置」→ instrumentum「装备、器具」→ 古法语 instrument → 中古英语 instrument；同根词 structure、construct、instruction。

sensesIntro.en: Instrument is the hung tool: a polished device, a tuned one that sings, one taken down for grand plans, and paper with a seal.
sensesIntro.cn: instrument 是挂在墙上的工具：磨亮的仪器、会唱歌的调音工具、取下谋大事的手段，以及盖了章的文书。

core.en: Knowledge built into a handle, hung on a wall until needed.
core.cn: 被砌进握柄的知识，挂在墙上待命。

branches.en: PRECISION: delicate lab instruments.
branches.cn: 精密：实验室的精密仪器。

branches.en: MUSIC: the violin is a string instrument.
MEANS: trade as an instrument of empire.
branches.cn: 手段：贸易曾是帝国工具。

branches.en: DOCUMENT: both parties signed the instrument.
EQUIPMENT: tools hung ready on the wall.

intro.en: Instrument builds instrumental, instrumentation and instrumentalist.
intro.cn: instrument 构成 instrumental、instrumentation、instrumentalist。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries show the building verb behind the family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁条目展示词族背后的建造动词。

items.meaning: a built tool; a music maker

items.example: She was instrumental in the win.

definition_zh: 聪明的；智能的；有才智的
definition_en: able to learn, think and understand well; showing good judgment
core_image: 灯泡在头顶亮起的瞬间
scene: 小狗会自己开门闩了。An intelligent robot vacuum maps the room.
sceneCN: 这里 intelligent 是「智能的」（第 2 个义项：机器具备理解能力）；句意：智能扫地机器人会绘制房间地图。

derivatives.zh: intelligent 加名词后缀，义为「智力；情报」
intelligent 加副词后缀，义为「聪明地」
同源名词，义为「知识分子阶层」

senses.title: Quick to learn and think
senses.definition: good at learning, thinking and understanding
senses.definitionCN: 善于学习、思考与理解
senses.example: She is an intelligent student who asks sharp questions.
senses.exampleCN: 她是个聪明的学生，提问犀利。
senses.why: The bulb lights before others do.
senses.whyCN: 灯泡比别人家的先亮。

senses.title: Showing smart design in machines
senses.definition: able to gather data and act sensibly, of devices
senses.definitionCN: 指设备能采集数据并合理行动
senses.example: Intelligent traffic lights reduce jams.
senses.why: The bulb switches itself on when needed.
senses.whyCN: 灯泡会在需要时自动亮起。

senses.title: Wise in choice
senses.definition: showing good judgment in choices
senses.definitionCN: 在选择上表现出良好的判断力
senses.example: It was an intelligent decision to wait.
senses.why: The bulb stays dark when light would hurt.
senses.whyCN: 该暗时灯泡保持熄灭。

senses.title: Sly in a clever way
senses.definition: clever in a quick-witted, sometimes cunning way
senses.definitionCN: 机敏而略带狡黠的聪明
senses.example: An intelligent thief leaves no trace.
senses.why: The bulb winks before anyone notices.
senses.whyCN: 灯泡在无人注意时眨了眨。

intro.en: Intelligent comes from Latin intelligere, to choose between or understand, from inter- (between) and legere (to pick, to read). Mind as a picker of the right option.
intro.cn: intelligent 来自拉丁语 intelligere「在……之间挑选、理解」，由 inter-「之间」+ legere「挑选、阅读」构成；心智即挑选正确选项的读者。

items.en: Latin legere meant to pick out, to read; it gave elect, select and lecture.
items.cn: 拉丁语 legere 意为拣选、阅读；同根词有 elect、select、lecture。

items.en: inter- plus legere formed intelligere: to pick between, discern.
items.cn: inter- 加 legere 构成 intelligere：在两者间拣选、辨识。

items.en: intelligens named one who discerns well.
items.cn: intelligens 指善于辨识之人。

items.en: Old French lent the spelling the nt ending we still write.
items.cn: 古法语借来了我们沿用至今的 nt 结尾。

items.en: Middle English inteligent meant understanding.
items.cn: 中古英语 inteligent 意为善解。

items.en: Modern English applied it to people, choices and finally machines.
items.cn: 现代英语把它用于人、选择，最终用于机器。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the pick-root family. The meaning group compares words of bright minds.
note.cn: 形近组收录「拣选」词根词族；词义组比较头脑聪明的词。

entries.definition: the noun: mind power or secret reports.

entries.definitionCN: 口语中的机灵；也指潇洒。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the picking root, the lightbulb image and the machine twist.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩利用「拣选」词根、灯泡意象与机器转折。

normal.en: inter- plus legere: the mind picks the right option.
normal.cn: inter- 加 legere：心智拣出对的选项。

normal.en: elect and select share the picking root.
normal.cn: elect 与 select 共享拣选词根。

normal.en: intelligence is the noun twin, also spy reports.
normal.cn: intelligence 是名词孪生词，也指情报。

normal.en: an intelligent vacuum maps your room.
normal.cn: 智能吸尘器会画房间地图。

normal.en: intelligible means easy to understand.
normal.cn: intelligible 意为易懂的。

abstract.en: One image: a bulb that lights before the question ends.
abstract.cn: 只记一个画面：问题未完灯泡已亮。

abstract.en: To be intelligent is to read between the options.
abstract.cn: intelligent 就是在选项之间读出答案。

abstract.en: The lamp knows when to shine and when to rest.
abstract.cn: 这盏灯知道何时亮、何时歇。

examples.en: He gave an intelligent reply to a hard question.
examples.cn: 他对难题给出了聪明的回答。

examples.en: Dolphins are highly intelligent animals.
examples.cn: 海豚是非常聪明的动物。

examples.en: Invest your savings intelligently.
examples.cn: 要聪明地投资你的积蓄。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「因太利真特」：因脑子太利落，答案特别真， intelligent。

root: 拉丁语 inter-「之间」+ legere「拣选、阅读」→ intelligere「辨识、理解」→ intelligens「善辨识者」→ 古法语 → 中古英语 inteligent → 现代英语 intelligent；同根词 select、elect、lecture。

sensesIntro.en: Intelligent is the early bulb: a mind that picks fast, a machine that switches itself, a choice that waits wisely, and a wink of cunning.
sensesIntro.cn: intelligent 是先亮的灯泡：快速拣选的头脑、会自己开关的机器、懂得等待的明智，以及狡黠的一眨。

core.en: A bulb that lights before others, knowing when to shine and when to stay dark.
core.cn: 比别人先亮的灯泡，知道何时发光、何时熄灭。

branches.en: MIND: an intelligent student asks sharp questions.
branches.cn: 头脑：聪明学生提问犀利。

branches.en: MACHINE: intelligent traffic lights reduce jams.
branches.cn: 机器：智能红绿灯减拥堵。

branches.en: JUDGMENT: it was intelligent to wait.
CLEVERNESS: an intelligent thief leaves no trace.
PICKING: choosing well between options.

intro.en: Intelligent builds intelligence, intelligently and intelligible.
intro.cn: intelligent 构成 intelligence、intelligently、intelligible。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries show the picking verb legere behind the family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁条目展示词族背后的拣选动词 legere。

definition_en: a plan or aim in your mind before you act
core_image: 拉满却未放的弓：目标已定在弦上
scene: 少年攒了半年的零花钱，盯着橱窗里的望远镜。She has every intention of finishing the course.
sceneCN: 这里 intention 是「打算」（第 1 个义项：心中的计划）；句意：她完全打算修完这门课。

collocations.phrase: the road to ruin is paved with good intentions

derivatives.zh: intention 的动词基，义为「打算；想要」
intend 加过去分词后缀，义为「预期的；想要的」
同源名词，义为「意图」（法律语境常用）

senses.title: A plan held in the mind
senses.definition: an aim or plan you hold before acting
senses.definitionCN: 行动之前心中所持的目标或计划
senses.example: Her intention was to study abroad.
senses.why: The bow is drawn but not released.
senses.whyCN: 弓已拉满，箭未离弦。

senses.title: A purpose behind an action
senses.definition: the purpose that an action serves
senses.definitionCN: 行为所服务的目的
senses.example: The remark carried no bad intention.
senses.why: The drawn bow explains the aimed arrow.
senses.whyCN: 拉满的弓解释了箭的去向。

senses.title: Good intentions gone wrong
senses.definition: kind plans that fail in practice
senses.definitionCN: 实践中落空的好心计划
senses.example: His good intentions paved a bumpy road.
senses.exampleCN: 他的好心铺了条颠簸路。
senses.why: The string snaps though the aim was kind.
senses.whyCN: 弦断了，尽管箭头原是善意的。

senses.title: Legal intent in writing
senses.definition: a declared aim, formal or legal use
senses.definitionCN: 正式或法律语境中的声明目标
senses.example: The letter states the buyer's intentions.
senses.why: The bow is signed on paper.
senses.whyCN: 弓被签在了纸上。

intro.en: Intention comes from Latin intendere, to stretch toward, from in- (toward) and tendere (to stretch). An intention is a mind stretched toward a target.
intro.cn: intention 来自拉丁语 intendere「朝……张紧」，由 in-「朝向」+ tendere「拉伸」构成；intention 就是朝目标张紧的心。

items.en: Latin tendere meant to stretch; it gave tendon, tense and tent.
items.cn: 拉丁语 tendere 意为拉伸；同根词有 tendon、tense、tent。

items.en: in- plus tendere formed intendere: to stretch toward a mark.
items.cn: in- 加 tendere 构成 intendere：朝目标张紧。

items.en: intentio meant the stretching, then the mental aim.
items.cn: intentio 先指拉伸，后指心中之志。

items.en: Old French entencion carried both attention and aim.
items.cn: 古法语 entencion 兼指专注与目标。

items.en: Middle English entencioun settled on the mental aim.
items.cn: 中古英语 entencioun 落定于心中目标。

items.en: Modern English kept the drawn-bow image in every sense.
items.cn: 现代英语在各义中保留了拉满之弓的画面。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the stretch-root family. The meaning group compares words of plans.
note.cn: 形近组收录「拉伸」词根词族；词义组比较计划类词。

entries.definitionCN: 法律语境的意图孪生词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the stretched-bow image, the tend root and the good-intentions proverb.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩利用张满之弓意象、tend 词根与好心谚语。

normal.en: in- plus tendere (stretch): mind pulled toward a target.
normal.cn: in- 加 tendere（拉伸）：心被拉向目标。

normal.en: tendon and tense share the stretching root.
normal.cn: tendon 与 tense 共享拉伸词根。

normal.en: with the intention of plus verb-ing.
normal.cn: with the intention of 后接动名词。

normal.en: good intentions can pave a bumpy road.
normal.cn: 好心也能铺出颠簸路。

normal.en: attention is the same bow aimed at a lesson.
normal.cn: attention 是瞄准课堂的同一张弓。

abstract.en: One image: a bow fully drawn, arrow not yet flown.
abstract.cn: 只记一个画面：弓已拉满，箭未离弦。

abstract.en: Every act is an arrow; intention is the drawn string.
abstract.cn: 行为是箭，intention 是那根拉紧的弦。

abstract.en: The target does not see the bow, only the arrow.
abstract.cn: 靶子看不见弓，只看见箭。

examples.en: He opened the shop with the intention of helping locals.
examples.cn: 他开店的本意是帮街坊。

examples.en: I have no intention of quitting.
examples.cn: 我无意放弃。

examples.en: Good intentions alone do not finish projects.
examples.cn: 光有善意完不成项目。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「因ten申」：心中已有ten分打算，郑重申明， intention。

root: 拉丁语 in-「朝向」+ tendere「拉伸」→ intendere「朝目标张紧」→ intentio「心中之志」→ 古法语 entencion → 中古英语 entencioun → 现代英语 intention；同根词 tendon、tense、attention。

sensesIntro.en: Intention is the drawn bow: a plan held before action, the purpose behind the arrow, kind strings that snap, and a bow signed on paper.
sensesIntro.cn: intention 是拉满的弓：行动前的盘算、箭背后的目的、会断的善意之弦，以及签在纸上的弓。

core.en: A bow drawn toward a target before the arrow flies.
core.cn: 箭未离弦之前，已朝靶心拉满的弓。

branches.en: PLAN: her intention was to study abroad.
PURPOSE: the remark carried no bad intention.
GOODWILL: good intentions paved a bumpy road.
DECLARATION: the letter states intentions.
AIMING: mind stretched toward the mark.

intro.en: Intention builds intend, intended and keeps intent in law.
intro.cn: intention 构成 intend、intended，法律语境保留 intent。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries show the stretching verb tendere behind the family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁条目展示词族背后的拉伸动词 tendere。
